using namespace std;

class FastIO {
    static const int BUF_SIZE = 1 << 24;
    char buf[BUF_SIZE];
    int pos = 0, len = 0;
    FILE* f;
public:
    FastIO(FILE* f) : f(f) {
#ifdef _WIN32
        _setmode(_fileno(f), _O_BINARY);
#endif
    }
    inline char nextChar() {
        if (pos == len) {
            pos = 0;
            len = (int)fread(buf, 1, BUF_SIZE, f);
            if (len == 0) return EOF;
        }
        return buf[pos++];
    }
    
    inline bool readInt(int &x) {
        char c = nextChar();
        while (c <= ' ' && c != EOF) c = nextChar();
        if (c == EOF) return false;
        x = 0;
        bool sign = false;
        if (c == '-') { sign = true; c = nextChar(); }
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = nextChar();
        }
        if (sign) x = -x;
        return true;
    }
    
    inline bool readFloat(float &x) {
        char c = nextChar();
        while (c <= ' ' && c != EOF) c = nextChar();
        if (c == EOF) return false;
        bool sign = false;
        if (c == '-') { sign = true; c = nextChar(); }
        double res = 0;
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = nextChar();
        }
        if (c == '.') {
            c = nextChar();
            double frac = 1;
            while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                frac *= 0.1;
                res += (c - '0') * frac;
                c = nextChar();
            }
        }
        x = (float)(sign ? -res : res);
        return true;
    }
};

class FastOut {
    static const int BUF_SIZE = 1 << 24;
    char buf[BUF_SIZE];
    int pos = 0;
    FILE* f;
public:
    FastOut(FILE* f) : f(f) {
#ifdef _WIN32
        _setmode(_fileno(f), _O_BINARY);
#endif
    }
    ~FastOut() { flush(); }
    inline void flush() {
        if (pos > 0) {
            fwrite(buf, 1, pos, f);
            pos = 0;
        }
    }
    inline void writeInt(int x) {
        if (x == 0) {
            writeChar('0');
            return;
        }
        if (x < 0) {
            writeChar('-');
            x = -x;
        }
        char temp[12];
        int idx = 0;
        while (x > 0) {
            temp[idx++] = (x % 10) + '0';
            x /= 10;
        }
        for (int i = idx - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            writeChar(temp[i]);
        }
    }
    inline void writeChar(char c) {
        if (pos == BUF_SIZE) flush();
        buf[pos++] = c;
    }
};

inline uint64_t hilbert_d(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint64_t d = 0;
    for (int i = 31; i >= 0; i--) {
        uint32_t rx = (x >> i) & 1;
        uint32_t ry = (y >> i) & 1;
        d = (d << 2) | ((rx * 3) ^ ry);
        if (ry == 0) {
            if (rx == 1) {
                x = ~x;
                y = ~y;
            }
            uint32_t t = x;
            x = y;
            y = t;
        }
    }
    return d;
}

int main() {
    FastIO fio(stdin);
    int N;
    if (!fio.readInt(N)) return 0;

    vector<float> X(N), Y(N);
    float min_x = 1e9, max_x = -1e9;
    float min_y = 1e9, max_y = -1e9;

    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        fio.readFloat(X[i]);
        fio.readFloat(Y[i]);
        if (X[i] < min_x) min_x = X[i];
        if (X[i] > max_x) max_x = X[i];
        if (Y[i] < min_y) min_y = Y[i];
        if (Y[i] > max_y) max_y = Y[i];
    }

    float range_x = max_x - min_x;
    float range_y = max_y - min_y;
    float range = max(range_x, range_y);
    if (range == 0) range = 1;

    vector<uint64_t> H(N);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        uint32_t nx = (uint32_t)((X[i] - min_x) / range * 4294967295.0);
        uint32_t ny = (uint32_t)((Y[i] - min_y) / range * 4294967295.0);
        H[i] = hilbert_d(nx, ny);
    }

    vector<int> p(N);
    iota(p.begin(), p.end(), 0);
    sort(p.begin(), p.end(), [&](int a, int b) {
        return H[a] < H[b];
    });

    auto dist = [&](int a, int b) {
        float dx = X[a] - X[b];
        float dy = Y[a] - Y[b];
        return sqrtf(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    };

    if (N <= 1000) {
        vector<int> best_p = p;
        float best_cost = 1e18f;
        
        auto calc_cost = [&](const vector<int>& tour) {
            float cost = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                cost += dist(tour[i], tour[(i+1)%N]);
            }
            return cost;
        };

        int starts = (N <= 40) ? 2000 : (N <= 200 ? 200 : 20);
        std::mt19937 rng(1337);
        
        for (int s = 0; s < starts; s++) {
            vector<int> cur_p = p;
            if (s > 0) {
                if (s <= N) {
                    cur_p.clear();
                    vector<bool> vis(N, false);
                    int curr = s - 1;
                    cur_p.push_back(curr);
                    vis[curr] = true;
                    for (int i = 1; i < N; i++) {
                        int best_next = -1;
                        float min_d = 1e18f;
                        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                            if (!vis[j]) {
                                float d = dist(curr, j);
                                if (d < min_d) {
                                    min_d = d;
                                    best_next = j;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        curr = best_next;
                        cur_p.push_back(curr);
                        vis[curr] = true;
                    }
                } else {
                    shuffle(cur_p.begin(), cur_p.end(), rng);
                }
            }
            
            bool improved = true;
            while (improved) {
                improved = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < N - 2; i++) {
                    for (int j = i + 2; j < N; j++) {
                        int a = cur_p[i], b = cur_p[i+1];
                        int c = cur_p[j], d = (j + 1 < N) ? cur_p[j+1] : cur_p[0];
                        if (dist(a, c) + dist(b, d) < dist(a, b) + dist(c, d) - 1e-5f) {
                            reverse(cur_p.begin() + i + 1, cur_p.begin() + j + 1);
                            improved = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            float c_cost = calc_cost(cur_p);
            if (c_cost < best_cost) {
                best_cost = c_cost;
                best_p = cur_p;
            }
        }
        p = best_p;
    } else {
        int window = 0;
        int max_iters = 0;
        if (N <= 10000) { window = 500; max_iters = 20; }
        else if (N <= 50000) { window = 200; max_iters = 10; }
        else if (N <= 200000) { window = 50; max_iters = 5; }
        else if (N <= 1000000) { window = 15; max_iters = 2; }
        else { window = 0; max_iters = 0; } 

        auto time_start = chrono::steady_clock::now();
        for (int iter = 0; iter < max_iters; iter++) {
            bool improved = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < N - 2; i++) {
                int max_j = min(N - 1, i + window);
                for (int j = i + 2; j <= max_j; j++) {
                    int a = p[i], b = p[i+1];
                    int c = p[j], d = (j + 1 < N) ? p[j+1] : p[0];
                    float d1 = dist(a, b) + dist(c, d);
                    float d2 = dist(a, c) + dist(b, d);
                    if (d2 < d1 - 1e-5f) {
                        reverse(p.begin() + i + 1, p.begin() + j + 1);
                        improved = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            auto time_now = chrono::steady_clock::now();
            double elapsed = chrono::duration<double>(time_now - time_start).count();
            if (elapsed > 280.0) break;
            if (!improved) break;
        }
    }

    auto it = find(p.begin(), p.end(), 0);
    if (it != p.begin()) {
        rotate(p.begin(), it, p.end());
    }

    FastOut fout(stdout);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        if (i > 0) fout.writeChar(' ');
        fout.writeInt(p[i]);
    }
    fout.writeChar('\n');

    return 0;
}

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Collections.Generic;

class Program
{
    class Edge
    {
        public int Id;
        public int To;
        public long Weight;
    }

    static List<(int u, int v, long w)> all_edges;
    static List<Edge>[] graph;

    static void DuplicateEdge(int edgeId)
    {
        var e = all_edges[edgeId];
        int newId = all_edges.Count;
        all_edges.Add(e);
        graph[e.u].Add(new Edge { Id = newId, To = e.v, Weight = e.w });
        graph[e.v].Add(new Edge { Id = newId, To = e.u, Weight = e.w });
    }

    static int GetOtherEndpoint(int edgeId, int node)
    {
        var e = all_edges[edgeId];
        return e.u == node ? e.v : e.u;
    }

    static void SolveExactDP(List<int> oddNodes, int N)
    {
        int K = oddNodes.Count;
        long[][] dist = new long[K][];
        int[][] parent_edge = new int[K][];

        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++)
        {
            int start = oddNodes[i];
            dist[i] = new long[N];
            Array.Fill(dist[i], long.MaxValue);
            parent_edge[i] = new int[N];
            Array.Fill(parent_edge[i], -1);

            PriorityQueue<int, long> pq = new PriorityQueue<int, long>();
            dist[i][start] = 0;
            pq.Enqueue(start, 0);

            while (pq.Count > 0)
            {
                pq.TryDequeue(out int u, out long d);
                if (d > dist[i][u]) continue;

                int count = graph[u].Count;
                for (int idx = 0; idx < count; idx++)
                {
                    var edge = graph[u][idx];
                    int v = edge.To;
                    long w = edge.Weight;
                    if (dist[i][u] + w < dist[i][v])
                    {
                        dist[i][v] = dist[i][u] + w;
                        parent_edge[i][v] = edge.Id;
                        pq.Enqueue(v, dist[i][v]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long[] dp = new long[1 << K];
        Array.Fill(dp, long.MaxValue / 2);
        dp[0] = 0;
        int[] dp_parent = new int[1 << K];
        Array.Fill(dp_parent, -1);
        int[] dp_pair = new int[1 << K];

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << K); mask++)
        {
            if (dp[mask] >= long.MaxValue / 2) continue;

            int i = 0;
            while (i < K && ((mask >> i) & 1) == 1) i++;
            if (i == K) continue;

            for (int j = i + 1; j < K; j++)
            {
                if (((mask >> j) & 1) == 0)
                {
                    if (dist[i][oddNodes[j]] != long.MaxValue)
                    {
                        long cost = dp[mask] + dist[i][oddNodes[j]];
                        int nmask = mask | (1 << i) | (1 << j);
                        if (cost < dp[nmask])
                        {
                            dp[nmask] = cost;
                            dp_parent[nmask] = mask;
                            dp_pair[nmask] = (i << 16) | j;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int curr_mask = (1 << K) - 1;
        while (curr_mask > 0)
        {
            int pair = dp_pair[curr_mask];
            int a = pair >> 16;
            int b = pair & 0xFFFF;

            int curr = oddNodes[b];
            while (curr != oddNodes[a])
            {
                int e_id = parent_edge[a][curr];
                DuplicateEdge(e_id);
                curr = GetOtherEndpoint(e_id, curr);
            }

            curr_mask = dp_parent[curr_mask];
        }
    }

            int a = match.Item1;
            int b = match.Item2;
            int curr = oddNodes[b];
            while (curr != oddNodes[a])
            {
                int e_id = parent_edge[a][curr];
                DuplicateEdge(e_id);
                curr = GetOtherEndpoint(e_id, curr);
            }
        }
    }

    static void SolveMultiPhaseDijkstra(List<int> oddNodes, int N)
    {
        int K = oddNodes.Count;
        int unmatched_count = K;
        bool[] matched = new bool[N];

        while (unmatched_count > 0)
        {
            int initial_unmatched = unmatched_count;
            long[] dist = new long[N];
            Array.Fill(dist, long.MaxValue);
            int[] origin = new int[N];
            Array.Fill(origin, -1);
            int[] parent_edge = new int[N];
            Array.Fill(parent_edge, -1);

            PriorityQueue<int, long> pq = new PriorityQueue<int, long>();

            for (int i = 0; i < K; i++)
            {
                int u = oddNodes[i];
                if (!matched[u])
                {
                    dist[u] = 0;
                    origin[u] = u;
                    pq.Enqueue(u, 0);
                }
            }

            while (pq.Count > 0)
            {
                pq.TryDequeue(out int u, out long d);
                if (d > dist[u]) continue;

                if (matched[origin[u]]) continue;

                int count = graph[u].Count;
                for (int idx = 0; idx < count; idx++)
                {
                    var edge = graph[u][idx];
                    int v = edge.To;
                    long w = edge.Weight;
                    int origU = origin[u];
                    int origV = origin[v];

                    if (origV != -1 && origV != origU)
                    {
                        if (!matched[origU] && !matched[origV])
                        {
                            matched[origU] = true;
                            matched[origV] = true;
                            unmatched_count -= 2;

                            int curr = u;
                            while (curr != origU)
                            {
                                int e_id = parent_edge[curr];
                                DuplicateEdge(e_id);
                                curr = GetOtherEndpoint(e_id, curr);
                            }

                            DuplicateEdge(edge.Id);

                            curr = v;
                            while (curr != origV)
                            {
                                int e_id = parent_edge[curr];
                                DuplicateEdge(e_id);
                                curr = GetOtherEndpoint(e_id, curr);
                            }

                            break;
                        }
                    }

                    if (dist[u] + w < dist[v])
                    {
                        dist[v] = dist[u] + w;
                        origin[v] = origU;
                        parent_edge[v] = edge.Id;
                        pq.Enqueue(v, dist[v]);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (unmatched_count == initial_unmatched) break;
        }
    }

    static List<int> FindEulerianCircuit(int N, int totalEdgesCount)
    {
        bool[] edge_used = new bool[totalEdgesCount];
        int[] edge_idx = new int[N];
        List<int> circuit = new List<int>();
        Stack<int> stack = new Stack<int>();
        stack.Push(0);

        while (stack.Count > 0)
        {
            int u = stack.Peek();
            bool found = false;
            while (edge_idx[u] < graph[u].Count)
            {
                var edge = graph[u][edge_idx[u]];
                edge_idx[u]++;
                if (!edge_used[edge.Id])
                {
                    edge_used[edge.Id] = true;
                    stack.Push(edge.To);
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!found)
            {
                circuit.Add(stack.Pop());
            }
        }
        circuit.Reverse();
        return circuit;
    }

    public static void Main()
    {
        var scanner = new Scanner(Console.OpenStandardInput());
        int N = scanner.NextInt();
        if (N == -1) return;
        int M = scanner.NextInt();

        all_edges = new List<(int u, int v, long w)>(M);
        graph = new List<Edge>[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) graph[i] = new List<Edge>();

        int[] degree = new int[N];

        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++)
        {
            int u = scanner.NextInt();
            int v = scanner.NextInt();
            long w = scanner.NextLong();
            all_edges.Add((u, v, w));
            graph[u].Add(new Edge { Id = i, To = v, Weight = w });
            graph[v].Add(new Edge { Id = i, To = u, Weight = w });
            degree[u]++;
            degree[v]++;
        }

        List<int> oddNodes = new List<int>();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            if (degree[i] % 2 != 0) oddNodes.Add(i);
        }

        int K = oddNodes.Count;
        if (K > 0)
        {
            if (K <= 20)
            {
                SolveExactDP(oddNodes, N);
            }
            else if (K <= 500 && (long)K * M <= 20000000L)
            {
                SolveGreedy2Opt(oddNodes, N);
            }
            else
            {
                SolveMultiPhaseDijkstra(oddNodes, N);
            }
        }

        var circuit = FindEulerianCircuit(N, all_edges.Count);

        using var sw = new StreamWriter(Console.OpenStandardOutput(), bufferSize: 65536);
        for (int i = 0; i < circuit.Count; i++)
        {
            sw.Write(circuit[i]);
            if (i < circuit.Count - 1) sw.Write(" ");
        }
        sw.WriteLine();
    }

    class Scanner
    {
        private Stream stream;
        private byte[] buffer = new byte[1024 * 1024];
        private int head, tail;

        public Scanner(Stream stream)
        {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        public long NextLong()
        {
            int c = Read();
            while (c <= 32)
            {
                if (c == -1) return -1;
                c = Read();
            }
            bool negative = false;
            if (c == '-')
            {
                negative = true;
                c = Read();
            }
            long res = 0;
            while (c > 32)
            {
                res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = Read();
            }
            return negative ? -res : res;
        }

        public int NextInt()
        {
            return (int)NextLong();
        }

        private int Read()
        {
            if (head >= tail)
            {
                head = 0;
                tail = stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
                if (tail == 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[head++];
        }
    }
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <queue>
#include <set>
#include <algorithm>
#include <tuple>
#include <iomanip>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

struct Point {
    double x, y, z;
};

Point operator-(const Point& a, const Point& b) { return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z}; }
Point operator+(const Point& a, const Point& b) { return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z}; }
Point operator*(const Point& a, double s) { return {a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s}; }
Point operator/(const Point& a, double s) { return {a.x / s, a.y / s, a.z / s}; }
double dot(const Point& a, const Point& b) { return a.x*b.x + a.y*b.y + a.z*b.z; }
Point cross(const Point& a, const Point& b) {
    return {a.y*b.z - a.z*b.y, a.z*b.x - a.x*b.z, a.x*b.y - a.y*b.x};
}
double length(const Point& a) { return sqrt(dot(a, a)); }

struct Face { Point n; double d; };

struct Tet { double cx, cy, cz, rx, ry, rz; };

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int V;
    double e;
    if (!(cin >> V >> e)) return 0;

    vector<Point> pts(V);
    double min_x = 1e9, max_x = -1e9;
    double min_y = 1e9, max_y = -1e9;
    double min_z = 1e9, max_z = -1e9;

    for(int i=0; i<V; ++i) {
        cin >> pts[i].x >> pts[i].y >> pts[i].z;
        pts[i].x += (rand() * 1.0 / RAND_MAX - 0.5) * 1e-7;
        pts[i].y += (rand() * 1.0 / RAND_MAX - 0.5) * 1e-7;
        pts[i].z += (rand() * 1.0 / RAND_MAX - 0.5) * 1e-7;

        if(pts[i].x < min_x) min_x = pts[i].x;
        if(pts[i].x > max_x) max_x = pts[i].x;
        if(pts[i].y < min_y) min_y = pts[i].y;
        if(pts[i].y > max_y) max_y = pts[i].y;
        if(pts[i].z < min_z) min_z = pts[i].z;
        if(pts[i].z > max_z) max_z = pts[i].z;
    }

    if (V < 4) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    int p0 = 0;
    for(int i=1; i<V; ++i) if(pts[i].z < pts[p0].z) p0 = i;

    int p1 = -1;
    double min_sin = 2.0; 
    for(int i=0; i<V; ++i) {
        if(i == p0) continue;
        double len = length(pts[i] - pts[p0]);
        if(len < 1e-9) continue;
        double s = (pts[i].z - pts[p0].z) / len;
        if(s < min_sin) {
            min_sin = s;
            p1 = i;
        }
    }

    Point n_F = {0, 0, -1};
    Point A = pts[p0];
    Point B = pts[p1];
    Point u = B - A; u = u / length(u);

    int p2 = -1;
    double min_theta = 10.0;
    for(int i=0; i<V; ++i) {
        if(i == p0 || i == p1) continue;
        double Y = dot(pts[i] - A, n_F);
        double X = dot(pts[i] - A, cross(u, n_F));
        double theta = atan2(-Y, X);
        if(theta < min_theta) {
            min_theta = theta;
            p2 = i;
        }
    }

    vector<Face> hull;
    set<pair<int, int>> edges_done;
    queue<tuple<int, int, Point>> q;

    auto add_face = [&](int a, int b, int c) {
        Point n = cross(pts[b] - pts[a], pts[c] - pts[a]);
        double len = length(n);
        if(len < 1e-9) return;
        n = n / len;
        hull.push_back({n, dot(n, pts[a])});
        
        edges_done.insert({a, b});
        edges_done.insert({b, c});
        edges_done.insert({c, a});
        
        if (!edges_done.count({b, a})) q.push({b, a, n});
        if (!edges_done.count({c, b})) q.push({c, b, n});
        if (!edges_done.count({a, c})) q.push({a, c, n});
    };

    if (p1 != -1 && p2 != -1) {
        add_face(p1, p0, p2);
    }

    while(!q.empty()) {
        auto [a, b, nf] = q.front();
        q.pop();
        if (edges_done.count({a, b})) continue;

        Point pA = pts[a];
        Point pB = pts[b];
        Point dir = pB - pA; 
        double dirlen = length(dir);
        if(dirlen < 1e-9) continue;
        dir = dir / dirlen;

        int best_p = -1;
        double mt = 10.0;
        for(int i=0; i<V; ++i) {
            if(i == a || i == b) continue;
            double Y = dot(pts[i] - pA, nf);
            double X = dot(pts[i] - pA, cross(dir, nf));
            double theta = atan2(-Y, X);
            if(theta < mt) {
                mt = theta;
                best_p = i;
            }
        }

        if (best_p != -1) {
            add_face(b, a, best_p);
        }
    }

    double h = e * sqrt(2.0/3.0);
    double r = e / sqrt(24.0);
    double R = e * sqrt(3.0/8.0);
    
    int min_k = floor(min_z / h) - 1;
    int max_k = ceil(max_z / h) + 1;
    int min_j = floor(min_y / (e * sqrt(3.0)/2.0)) - 1;
    int max_j = ceil(max_y / (e * sqrt(3.0)/2.0)) + 1;
    int min_i = floor(min_x / e) - 1;
    int max_i = ceil(max_x / e) + 1;

    auto check_tet = [&](const Point& v0, const Point& v1, const Point& v2, const Point& v3) {
        for(const auto& f : hull) {
            if (dot(v0, f.n) > f.d + 1e-6) return false;
            if (dot(v1, f.n) > f.d + 1e-6) return false;
            if (dot(v2, f.n) > f.d + 1e-6) return false;
            if (dot(v3, f.n) > f.d + 1e-6) return false;
        }
        return true;
    };

    vector<Tet> result;

    for(int k = min_k; k <= max_k; ++k) {
        double cz = k * h;
        for(int j = min_j; j <= max_j; ++j) {
            for(int i = min_i; i <= max_i; ++i) {
                double cx_up = i * e + (j % 2 != 0 ? e/2.0 : 0.0);
                double cy_up = j * e * sqrt(3.0)/2.0;
                
                Point v0_up = {cx_up, cy_up, cz + R};
                Point v1_up = {cx_up, cy_up + e/sqrt(3.0), cz - r};
                Point v2_up = {cx_up + e/2.0, cy_up - e/(2.0*sqrt(3.0)), cz - r};
                Point v3_up = {cx_up - e/2.0, cy_up - e/(2.0*sqrt(3.0)), cz - r};

                if (check_tet(v0_up, v1_up, v2_up, v3_up)) {
                    result.push_back({cx_up, cy_up, cz, 0, 0, 0});
                }

                double cx_dn = cx_up + e/2.0;
                double cy_dn = cy_up + e/(2.0*sqrt(3.0));

                Point v0_dn = {cx_dn, cy_dn, cz + R};
                Point v1_dn = {cx_dn, cy_dn - e/sqrt(3.0), cz - r};
                Point v2_dn = {cx_dn - e/2.0, cy_dn + e/(2.0*sqrt(3.0)), cz - r};
                Point v3_dn = {cx_dn + e/2.0, cy_dn + e/(2.0*sqrt(3.0)), cz - r};

                if (check_tet(v0_dn, v1_dn, v2_dn, v3_dn)) {
                    result.push_back({cx_dn, cy_dn, cz, 0, 0, 3.14159265358979323846});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    cout << result.size() << "\n";
    cout << fixed << setprecision(6);
    for(const auto& t : result) {
        cout << t.cx << " " << t.cy << " " << t.cz << " " 
             << t.rx << " " << t.ry << " " << t.rz << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;

class Program
{
    struct Vector3
    {
        public double X, Y, Z;
        public Vector3(double x, double y, double z) { X = x; Y = y; Z = z; }
        public static Vector3 operator +(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) => new Vector3(a.X + b.X, a.Y + b.Y, a.Z + b.Z);
        public static Vector3 operator -(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) => new Vector3(a.X - b.X, a.Y - b.Y, a.Z - b.Z);
        public static Vector3 operator *(Vector3 a, double d) => new Vector3(a.X * d, a.Y * d, a.Z * d);
        public static Vector3 operator /(Vector3 a, double d) => new Vector3(a.X / d, a.Y / d, a.Z / d);
        public static double Dot(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) => a.X * b.X + a.Y * b.Y + a.Z * b.Z;
        public static Vector3 Cross(Vector3 a, Vector3 b) => new Vector3(a.Y * b.Z - a.Z * b.Y, a.Z * b.X - a.X * b.Z, a.X * b.Y - a.Y * b.X);
        public double Length() => Math.Sqrt(X * X + Y * Y + Z * Z);
    }

    struct Orbit
    {
        public int Id;
        public Vector3 R, V;
        public Vector3 H, E, N;
        public double A;
        public double Vc;
    }

    static Orbit ParseOrbit(int id, string line, double mu)
    {
        var parts = line.Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        var r = new Vector3(double.Parse(parts[0]), double.Parse(parts[1]), double.Parse(parts[2]));
        var v = new Vector3(double.Parse(parts[3]), double.Parse(parts[4]), double.Parse(parts[5]));
        
        var h = Vector3.Cross(r, v);
        var e = Vector3.Cross(v, h) / mu - r / r.Length();
        double rMag = r.Length();
        double vMag = v.Length();
        double energy = vMag * vMag / 2 - mu / rMag;
        double a = -mu / (2 * energy);
        double vc = Math.Sqrt(mu / Math.Abs(a));

        double hLen = h.Length();
        return new Orbit { Id = id, R = r, V = v, H = h, E = e, N = hLen > 0 ? h / hLen : new Vector3(0,0,1), A = a, Vc = vc };
    }

    static double GetCost(Orbit o1, Orbit o2, double mu)
    {
        double dotN = Math.Max(-1, Math.Min(1, Vector3.Dot(o1.N, o2.N)));
        double delta_i = Math.Acos(dotN);
        double dv_plane = 2 * Math.Min(o1.Vc, o2.Vc) * Math.Sin(delta_i / 2.0);
        
        double dv_hohmann = 0;
        if (o1.A > 0 && o2.A > 0)
        {
            dv_hohmann = Math.Abs(Math.Sqrt(mu / o1.A) * (Math.Sqrt(2 * o2.A / (o1.A + o2.A)) - 1)) +
                         Math.Abs(Math.Sqrt(mu / o2.A) * (1 - Math.Sqrt(2 * o1.A / (o1.A + o2.A))));
        }
        else
        {
            dv_hohmann = Math.Abs(o1.Vc - o2.Vc);
        }
        
        double dv_ecc = (o1.Vc + o2.Vc) / 2.0 * (o1.E - o2.E).Length();
        
        return dv_plane + dv_hohmann + dv_ecc;
    }

    static void Reverse(int[] arr, int i, int j)
    {
        while (i < j)
        {
            int temp = arr[i];
            arr[i] = arr[j];
            arr[j] = temp;
            i++;
            j--;
        }
    }

    static double CalcCost(int[] tour, double[,] costMatrix)
    {
        double cost = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < tour.Length - 1; i++)
        {
            cost += costMatrix[tour[i], tour[i + 1]];
        }
        return cost;
    }

    static void Main()
    {
        System.Threading.Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentCulture = System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
        string firstLine = null;
        while (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(firstLine = Console.ReadLine())) { if (firstLine == null) return; }
        
        var parts = firstLine.Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        int N = int.Parse(parts[0]);
        double mu = double.Parse(parts[1]);

        if (N < 1) return;
        if (N == 1)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("0");
            return;
        }

        string startLine = null;
        while (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(startLine = Console.ReadLine())) { if (startLine == null) return; }
        Orbit startOrbit = ParseOrbit(-1, startLine, mu);

        Orbit[] stations = new Orbit[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            string line = null;
            while (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line = Console.ReadLine())) { if (line == null) break; }
            stations[i] = ParseOrbit(i, line, mu);
        }

        double[,] costMatrix = new double[N + 1, N + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            costMatrix[0, i + 1] = GetCost(startOrbit, stations[i], mu);
            costMatrix[i + 1, 0] = double.MaxValue;
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++)
            {
                if (i == j) costMatrix[i + 1, j + 1] = 0;
                else costMatrix[i + 1, j + 1] = GetCost(stations[i], stations[j], mu);
            }
        }
        
        int[] currentTour = new int[N + 1];
        bool[] visited = new bool[N + 1];
        currentTour[0] = 0;
        visited[0] = true;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++)
        {
            int lastNode = currentTour[i - 1];
            double minCost = double.MaxValue;
            int bestNext = -1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; j++)
            {
                if (!visited[j] && costMatrix[lastNode, j] < minCost)
                {
                    minCost = costMatrix[lastNode, j];
                    bestNext = j;
                }
            }
            currentTour[i] = bestNext;
            visited[bestNext] = true;
        }

        bool improved = true;
        while (improved)
        {
            improved = false;
            for (int i = 1; i < N; i++)
            {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= N; j++)
                {
                    double oldEdges = costMatrix[currentTour[i - 1], currentTour[i]];
                    if (j < N) oldEdges += costMatrix[currentTour[j], currentTour[j + 1]];
                    
                    double newEdges = costMatrix[currentTour[i - 1], currentTour[j]];
                    if (j < N) newEdges += costMatrix[currentTour[i], currentTour[j + 1]];
                    
                    if (newEdges < oldEdges - 1e-6)
                    {
                        Reverse(currentTour, i, j);
                        improved = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int[] globalBestTour = (int[])currentTour.Clone();
        double globalBestCost = CalcCost(globalBestTour, costMatrix);

        Random rnd = new Random(42);
        int numRestarts = 10;
        long maxMillis = 5000 / numRestarts; 
        
        for (int restart = 0; restart < numRestarts; restart++)
        {
            if (restart > 0)
            {
                for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++)
                {
                    int swapIdx = rnd.Next(1, N + 1);
                    int temp = currentTour[i];
                    currentTour[i] = currentTour[swapIdx];
                    currentTour[swapIdx] = temp;
                }
                
                bool imp = true;
                while (imp)
                {
                    imp = false;
                    for (int i = 1; i < N; i++)
                    {
                        for (int j = i + 1; j <= N; j++)
                        {
                            double oldE = costMatrix[currentTour[i - 1], currentTour[i]];
                            if (j < N) oldE += costMatrix[currentTour[j], currentTour[j + 1]];
                            
                            double newE = costMatrix[currentTour[i - 1], currentTour[j]];
                            if (j < N) newE += costMatrix[currentTour[i], currentTour[j + 1]];
                            
                            if (newE < oldE - 1e-6)
                            {
                                Reverse(currentTour, i, j);
                                imp = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            int[] workingTour = (int[])currentTour.Clone();
            double currentCost = CalcCost(workingTour, costMatrix);
            
            double T_start = currentCost * 0.1;
            if (T_start < 1) T_start = 100;
            double T_end = 1e-4;
            
            Stopwatch sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
            int iter = 0;
            while (sw.ElapsedMilliseconds < maxMillis)
            {
                iter++;
                if (iter % 1000 == 0) currentCost = CalcCost(workingTour, costMatrix);
                
                int i = rnd.Next(1, N);
                int j = rnd.Next(i + 1, N + 1);
                
                double oldEdges = costMatrix[workingTour[i - 1], workingTour[i]];
                if (j < N) oldEdges += costMatrix[workingTour[j], workingTour[j + 1]];
                
                double newEdges = costMatrix[workingTour[i - 1], workingTour[j]];
                if (j < N) newEdges += costMatrix[workingTour[i], workingTour[j + 1]];
                
                double delta = newEdges - oldEdges;
                
                double fraction = (double)sw.ElapsedMilliseconds / maxMillis;
                if (fraction > 1.0) fraction = 1.0;
                double temp = T_start * Math.Pow(T_end / T_start, fraction);
                
                if (delta < 0 || Math.Exp(-delta / temp) > rnd.NextDouble())
                {
                    Reverse(workingTour, i, j);
                    currentCost += delta;
                    
                    if (currentCost < globalBestCost)
                    {
                        globalBestCost = currentCost;
                        Array.Copy(workingTour, globalBestTour, N + 1);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        var resultIndices = new List<string>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++)
        {
            resultIndices.Add((globalBestTour[i] - 1).ToString());
        }
        Console.WriteLine(string.Join(" ", resultIndices));
    }
}

use std::collections::VecDeque;
use std::io::{self, BufRead, Write};
use std::str::FromStr;

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut stdin_lock = stdin.lock();
    
    let mut header = String::new();
    if stdin_lock.read_line(&mut header).unwrap() == 0 {
        return;
    }
    
    let parts: Vec<&str> = header.split_whitespace().collect();
    if parts.len() < 2 {
        return;
    }
    let h: usize = usize::from_str(parts[0]).unwrap();
    let w: usize = usize::from_str(parts[1]).unwrap();
    
    let mut grid: Vec<u8> = vec![0; h * w];
    let mut start = None;
    let mut end = None;
    
    let mut line = String::new();
    for y in 0..h {
        line.clear();
        stdin_lock.read_line(&mut line).unwrap();
        let bytes = line.as_bytes();
        let mut x = 0;
        for &b in bytes.iter() {
            if b == b'\n' || b == b'\r' {
                continue;
            }
            if x >= w {
                break;
            }
            let idx = y * w + x;
            match b {
                b'#' => grid[idx] = 1,
                b'A' => {
                    start = Some((x, y));
                    grid[idx] = 0;
                }
                b'B' => {
                    end = Some((x, y));
                    grid[idx] = 0;
                }
                _ => {
                    grid[idx] = 0;
                }
            }
            x += 1;
        }
    }
    
    if start.is_none() || end.is_none() {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }
    
    let (sx, sy) = start.unwrap();
    let (ex, ey) = end.unwrap();
    
    // We search from end to start.
    let mut queue = VecDeque::new();
    queue.push_back((ex, ey));
    grid[ey * w + ex] = 6; // Mark end as visited with special marker
    
    let mut found = false;
    
    while let Some((x, y)) = queue.pop_front() {
        if x == sx && y == sy {
            found = true;
            break;
        }
        
        // Check UP (x, y-1)
        if y > 0 {
            let ny = y - 1;
            let nx = x;
            let idx = ny * w + nx;
            if grid[idx] == 0 {
                grid[idx] = 3; // To go back, go DOWN
                queue.push_back((nx, ny));
            }
        }
        // Check DOWN (x, y+1)
        if y + 1 < h {
            let ny = y + 1;
            let nx = x;
            let idx = ny * w + nx;
            if grid[idx] == 0 {
                grid[idx] = 2; // To go back, go UP
                queue.push_back((nx, ny));
            }
        }
        // Check LEFT (x-1, y)
        if x > 0 {
            let ny = y;
            let nx = x - 1;
            let idx = ny * w + nx;
            if grid[idx] == 0 {
                grid[idx] = 5; // To go back, go RIGHT
                queue.push_back((nx, ny));
            }
        }
        // Check RIGHT (x+1, y)
        if x + 1 < w {
            let ny = y;
            let nx = x + 1;
            let idx = ny * w + nx;
            if grid[idx] == 0 {
                grid[idx] = 4; // To go back, go LEFT
                queue.push_back((nx, ny));
            }
        }
    }
    
    if !found {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }
    
    let mut len = 1;
    let mut curr_x = sx;
    let mut curr_y = sy;
    
    while curr_x != ex || curr_y != ey {
        let marker = grid[curr_y * w + curr_x];
        match marker {
            2 => curr_y -= 1, // go UP
            3 => curr_y += 1, // go DOWN
            4 => curr_x -= 1, // go LEFT
            5 => curr_x += 1, // go RIGHT
            _ => panic!("Invalid path"),
        }
        len += 1;
    }
    
    let stdout = io::stdout();
    let mut out = io::BufWriter::new(stdout.lock());
    
    writeln!(out, "{}", len).unwrap();
    
    curr_x = sx;
    curr_y = sy;
    writeln!(out, "{} {}", curr_x, curr_y).unwrap();
    
    while curr_x != ex || curr_y != ey {
        let marker = grid[curr_y * w + curr_x];
        match marker {
            2 => curr_y -= 1,
            3 => curr_y += 1,
            4 => curr_x -= 1,
            5 => curr_x += 1,
            _ => unreachable!(),
        }
        writeln!(out, "{} {}", curr_x, curr_y).unwrap();
    }
}

using System;
using System.IO;

class Program
{
    struct Cut : IComparable<Cut>
    {
        public int len;
        public int id;
        public int CompareTo(Cut other)
        {
            return other.len.CompareTo(this.len); // descending
        }
    }

    static int[] tree;
    static int stock_length;

    static void Build(int node, int start, int end)
    {
        if (start == end)
        {
            tree[node] = stock_length;
            return;
        }
        int mid = (start + end) / 2;
        Build(2 * node, start, mid);
        Build(2 * node + 1, mid + 1, end);
        tree[node] = stock_length;
    }

    static int QueryAndUpdate(int node, int start, int end, int cut)
    {
        if (start == end)
        {
            tree[node] -= cut;
            return start;
        }
        int mid = (start + end) / 2;
        int res;
        if (tree[2 * node] >= cut)
        {
            res = QueryAndUpdate(2 * node, start, mid, cut);
        }
        else
        {
            res = QueryAndUpdate(2 * node + 1, mid + 1, end, cut);
        }
        tree[node] = Math.Max(tree[2 * node], tree[2 * node + 1]);
        return res;
    }

    static void Main()
    {
        using Stream stdin = Console.OpenStandardInput();
        byte[] buffer = new byte[1024 * 1024];
        int head = 0, tail = 0;

        int Read()
        {
            if (head >= tail)
            {
                head = 0;
                tail = stdin.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
                if (tail == 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[head++];
        }

        int NextInt()
        {
            int c = Read();
            while (c <= 32)
            {
                if (c == -1) return -1;
                c = Read();
            }
            int res = 0;
            while (c > 32)
            {
                res = res * 10 + c - '0';
                c = Read();
            }
            return res;
        }

        int n = NextInt();
        if (n <= 0) return;
        stock_length = NextInt();

        Cut[] cuts = new Cut[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            cuts[i] = new Cut { len = NextInt(), id = i };
        }

        Array.Sort(cuts);

        tree = new int[4 * n];
        Build(1, 0, n - 1);

        int[] bin_head = new int[n];
        int[] cut_next = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) bin_head[i] = -1;
        int max_bin = -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            int bin_idx = QueryAndUpdate(1, 0, n - 1, cuts[i].len);
            if (bin_idx > max_bin) max_bin = bin_idx;
            
            cut_next[cuts[i].id] = bin_head[bin_idx];
            bin_head[bin_idx] = cuts[i].id;
        }

        int num_stocks = max_bin + 1;

        using var sw = new StreamWriter(Console.OpenStandardOutput(), bufferSize: 1024 * 1024);
        sw.WriteLine(num_stocks);

        for (int i = 0; i < num_stocks; i++)
        {
            int curr = bin_head[i];
            bool first = true;
            while (curr != -1)
            {
                if (!first) sw.Write(" ");
                sw.Write(curr);
                first = false;
                curr = cut_next[curr];
            }
            sw.WriteLine();
        }
    }
}

Pack a set of rectangles into as few fixed-size boards as possible, with no overlapping. Rectangles may be rotated 90° to fit better. Think of it like fitting as many labels as you can onto sheets of card stock.

This 2D packing problem is NP-hard. Subpasses increase the number and variety of rectangles. The baseline stacks rectangles in simple horizontal rows.

2D Cutting Stock - 4 rectangles, 100x100 board

View Code (4852 chars)
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

struct Rect {
    int id;
    int w, h;
};

struct Placed {
    int board_index;
    int x, y;
    int rotated;
};

struct FreeRect {
    int x, y, w, h;
};

struct Board {
    vector<FreeRect> free_rects;
    int max_dim;
    Board(int W, int H) {
        free_rects.push_back({0, 0, W, H});
        max_dim = max(W, H);
    }
    void update_max() {
        max_dim = 0;
        for (const auto& fr : free_rects) {
            max_dim = max(max_dim, max(fr.w, fr.h));
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int N, W, H;
    if (!(cin >> N >> W >> H)) return 0;

    vector<Rect> rects(N);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        rects[i].id = i;
        cin >> rects[i].w >> rects[i].h;
    }

    // Sort rectangles by area descending, then by maximum side
    sort(rects.begin(), rects.end(), [](const Rect& a, const Rect& b) {
        long long areaA = (long long)a.w * a.h;
        long long areaB = (long long)b.w * b.h;
        if (areaA != areaB) return areaA > areaB;
        return max(a.w, a.h) > max(b.w, b.h);
    });

    vector<Board> boards;
    vector<Placed> result(N);

    for (const auto& r : rects) {
        int best_board = -1;
        int best_free_idx = -1;
        bool best_rotated = false;
        int best_score1 = 2e9; // min short side
        int best_score2 = 2e9; // min long side
        
        int min_r_dim = min(r.w, r.h);
        
        // Find Best Short Side Fit
        for (int b = 0; b < boards.size(); ++b) {
            if (boards[b].max_dim < min_r_dim) continue;
            
            for (int f = 0; f < boards[b].free_rects.size(); ++f) {
                const auto& fr = boards[b].free_rects[f];
                
                // Try not rotated
                if (r.w <= fr.w && r.h <= fr.h) {
                    int short_side = min(fr.w - r.w, fr.h - r.h);
                    int long_side = max(fr.w - r.w, fr.h - r.h);
                    if (short_side < best_score1 || (short_side == best_score1 && long_side < best_score2)) {
                        best_score1 = short_side;
                        best_score2 = long_side;
                        best_board = b;
                        best_free_idx = f;
                        best_rotated = false;
                    }
                }
                
                // Try rotated
                if (r.h <= fr.w && r.w <= fr.h) {
                    int short_side = min(fr.w - r.h, fr.h - r.w);
                    int long_side = max(fr.w - r.h, fr.h - r.w);
                    if (short_side < best_score1 || (short_side == best_score1 && long_side < best_score2)) {
                        best_score1 = short_side;
                        best_score2 = long_side;
                        best_board = b;
                        best_free_idx = f;
                        best_rotated = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (best_score1 == 0 && best_score2 == 0) break; // perfect fit, prune search
        }
        
        // No fit found, add a new board
        if (best_board == -1) {
            boards.push_back(Board(W, H));
            best_board = boards.size() - 1;
            best_free_idx = 0;
            
            const auto& fr = boards[best_board].free_rects[best_free_idx];
            if (r.w <= fr.w && r.h <= fr.h) {
                best_rotated = false;
            } else {
                best_rotated = true;
            }
        }
        
        int bw = best_rotated ? r.h : r.w;
        int bh = best_rotated ? r.w : r.h;
        
        FreeRect fr = boards[best_board].free_rects[best_free_idx];
        boards[best_board].free_rects.erase(boards[best_board].free_rects.begin() + best_free_idx);
        
        // Split the remaining space (Guillotine split, Minimize Area Split)
        int dw = fr.w - bw;
        int dh = fr.h - bh;
        
        if (dw > 0 || dh > 0) {
            FreeRect f1, f2;
            if (dw > dh) { 
                f1 = {fr.x + bw, fr.y, dw, fr.h};
                f2 = {fr.x, fr.y + bh, bw, dh};
            } else {
                f1 = {fr.x + bw, fr.y, dw, bh};
                f2 = {fr.x, fr.y + bh, fr.w, dh};
            }
            if (f1.w > 0 && f1.h > 0) boards[best_board].free_rects.push_back(f1);
            if (f2.w > 0 && f2.h > 0) boards[best_board].free_rects.push_back(f2);
        }
        
        boards[best_board].update_max();
        result[r.id] = {best_board, fr.x, fr.y, best_rotated ? 1 : 0};
    }

    // Output
    cout << boards.size() << "\n";
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        cout << result[i].board_index << " " << result[i].x << " " << result[i].y << " " << result[i].rotated << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

use std::io::{self, BufRead};

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
struct Point {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
struct Polygon {
    vertices: Vec<Point>,
}

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut lines = stdin.lock().lines().map(|l| l.unwrap());

    let first_line = match lines.next() {
        Some(l) => l,
        None => return,
    };
    
    let parts: Vec<&str> = first_line.split_whitespace().collect();
    if parts.len() < 2 {
        return;
    }
    
    let sv: usize = parts[0].parse().unwrap_or(0);
    let np: usize = parts[1].parse().unwrap_or(0);

    let mut stock = Polygon { vertices: Vec::new() };
    for _ in 0..sv {
        if let Some(line) = lines.next() {
            let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split_whitespace().collect();
            if parts.len() >= 2 {
                stock.vertices.push(Point {
                    x: parts[0].parse().unwrap_or(0.0),
                    y: parts[1].parse().unwrap_or(0.0),
                });
            }
        }
    }

    let mut pieces = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..np {
        if let Some(line) = lines.next() {
            let pv: usize = line.trim().parse().unwrap_or(0);
            let mut piece = Polygon { vertices: Vec::new() };
            for _ in 0..pv {
                if let Some(line) = lines.next() {
                    let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split_whitespace().collect();
                    if parts.len() >= 2 {
                        piece.vertices.push(Point {
                            x: parts[0].parse().unwrap_or(0.0),
                            y: parts[1].parse().unwrap_or(0.0),
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
            pieces.push(piece);
        }
    }

    // Simplest naive placement: each piece in its own stock index.
    // Assuming the piece fits within the stock at coordinates (0, 0) and 0 rotation.
    // For a highly robust implementation, one would use No-Fit Polygons (NFP)
    // and complex nesting algorithms (like Bottom-Left-Fill).
    println!("{}", np);
    for i in 0..np {
        println!("{} 0.0 0.0 0.0", i);
    }
}

        int countY = (int)Math.Floor(H / dy);

        if (countX <= 0 || countY <= 0 || countZ <= 0)

        int total = countX * countY * countZ;

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

struct Hash128 {
    uint64_t h1, h2;
    bool operator<(const Hash128& o) const {
        if (h1 != o.h1) return h1 < o.h1;
        return h2 < o.h2;
    }
    bool operator==(const Hash128& o) const {
        return h1 == o.h1 && h2 == o.h2;
    }
};

const uint64_t base1 = 257;
const uint64_t base2 = 313;

bool check(int len, const std::vector<std::string>& strings, int& best_start, const std::vector<uint64_t>& p1, const std::vector<uint64_t>& p2) {
    if (len == 0) return true;
    std::vector<Hash128> valid;
    
    valid.reserve(strings[0].size() - len + 1);
    uint64_t cur_h1 = 0, cur_h2 = 0;
    for (int j = 0; j < len; ++j) {
        cur_h1 = cur_h1 * base1 + strings[0][j];
        cur_h2 = cur_h2 * base2 + strings[0][j];
    }
    valid.push_back({cur_h1, cur_h2});
    
    uint64_t pw1 = p1[len];
    uint64_t pw2 = p2[len];
    
    for (int j = len; j < (int)strings[0].size(); ++j) {
        cur_h1 = cur_h1 * base1 + strings[0][j] - strings[0][j - len] * pw1;
        cur_h2 = cur_h2 * base2 + strings[0][j] - strings[0][j - len] * pw2;
        valid.push_back({cur_h1, cur_h2});
    }
    
    std::sort(valid.begin(), valid.end());
    valid.erase(std::unique(valid.begin(), valid.end()), valid.end());
    
    for (size_t i = 1; i < strings.size(); ++i) {
        std::vector<Hash128> next_valid;
        if (strings[i].size() < len) return false;
        
        if (valid.size() < 1000000) {
            // Adaptive Strategy 1: Binary Search when candidate pool is small
            cur_h1 = 0; cur_h2 = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < len; ++j) {
                cur_h1 = cur_h1 * base1 + strings[i][j];
                cur_h2 = cur_h2 * base2 + strings[i][j];
            }
            Hash128 h = {cur_h1, cur_h2};
            if (std::binary_search(valid.begin(), valid.end(), h)) {
                next_valid.push_back(h);
            }
            
            for (int j = len; j < (int)strings[i].size(); ++j) {
                cur_h1 = cur_h1 * base1 + strings[i][j] - strings[i][j - len] * pw1;
                cur_h2 = cur_h2 * base2 + strings[i][j] - strings[i][j - len] * pw2;
                h = {cur_h1, cur_h2};
                if (std::binary_search(valid.begin(), valid.end(), h)) {
                    next_valid.push_back(h);
                }
            }
            std::sort(next_valid.begin(), next_valid.end());
            next_valid.erase(std::unique(next_valid.begin(), next_valid.end()), next_valid.end());
        } else {
            // Adaptive Strategy 2: Sort and Intersect when candidate pool is large
            std::vector<Hash128> current;
            current.reserve(strings[i].size() - len + 1);
            
            cur_h1 = 0; cur_h2 = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < len; ++j) {
                cur_h1 = cur_h1 * base1 + strings[i][j];
                cur_h2 = cur_h2 * base2 + strings[i][j];
            }
            current.push_back({cur_h1, cur_h2});
            
            for (int j = len; j < (int)strings[i].size(); ++j) {
                cur_h1 = cur_h1 * base1 + strings[i][j] - strings[i][j - len] * pw1;
                cur_h2 = cur_h2 * base2 + strings[i][j] - strings[i][j - len] * pw2;
                current.push_back({cur_h1, cur_h2});
            }
            std::sort(current.begin(), current.end());
            
            std::set_intersection(valid.begin(), valid.end(),
                                  current.begin(), current.end(),
                                  std::back_inserter(next_valid));
            next_valid.erase(std::unique(next_valid.begin(), next_valid.end()), next_valid.end());
        }
        
        valid = std::move(next_valid);
        if (valid.empty()) return false;
    }
    
    if (!valid.empty()) {
        cur_h1 = 0; cur_h2 = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < len; ++j) {
            cur_h1 = cur_h1 * base1 + strings[0][j];
            cur_h2 = cur_h2 * base2 + strings[0][j];
        }
        if (std::binary_search(valid.begin(), valid.end(), Hash128{cur_h1, cur_h2})) {
            best_start = 0;
            return true;
        }
        for (int j = len; j < (int)strings[0].size(); ++j) {
            cur_h1 = cur_h1 * base1 + strings[0][j] - strings[0][j - len] * pw1;
            cur_h2 = cur_h2 * base2 + strings[0][j] - strings[0][j - len] * pw2;
            if (std::binary_search(valid.begin(), valid.end(), Hash128{cur_h1, cur_h2})) {
                best_start = j - len + 1;
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

int main() {
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(NULL);
    
    std::string line;
    if (!std::getline(std::cin, line)) return 0;
    int n = 0;
    try { n = std::stoi(line); } catch(...) { return 0; }
    if (n <= 0) {
        std::cout << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    
    std::vector<std::string> strings;
    strings.reserve(n);
    int max_len = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (!std::getline(std::cin, line)) break;
        if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back();
        strings.push_back(line);
        max_len = std::max(max_len, (int)line.size());
    }
    
    if (strings.empty()) {
        std::cout << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    
    // Adaptive logic: Sort strings so we process the shortest first
    // This minimizes the initial candidate pool size for valid hashes
    std::sort(strings.begin(), strings.end(), [](const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {
        return a.size() < b.size();
    });
    
    int min_len = strings[0].size();
    if (min_len == 0) {
        std::cout << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    
    std::vector<uint64_t> p1(max_len + 1), p2(max_len + 1);
    p1[0] = 1; p2[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= max_len; ++i) {
        p1[i] = p1[i-1] * base1;
        p2[i] = p2[i-1] * base2;
    }
    
    int low = 1, high = min_len;
    int best_len = 0;
    int best_start = 0;
    
    while (low <= high) {
        int mid = low + (high - low) / 2;
        int start = -1;
        if (check(mid, strings, start, p1, p2)) {
            best_len = mid;
            best_start = start;
            low = mid + 1;
        } else {
            high = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    
    if (best_len > 0) {
        std::cout << strings[0].substr(best_start, best_len) << "\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "\n";
    }
    
    return 0;
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

namespace MinesweeperSolver
{
    class Program
    {
        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            var lines = new List<string>();
            string line;
            while ((line = Console.ReadLine()) != null)
            {
                lines.Add(line);
            }

            if (lines.Count == 0) return;

            string[] dims = lines[0].Split(new[] { ' ' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
            int h = int.Parse(dims[0]);
            int w = int.Parse(dims[1]);

            char[][] board = new char[h][];
            for (int i = 0; i < h; i++)
            {
                board[i] = lines[i + 1].ToCharArray();
            }

            Solver solver = new Solver(h, w, board);
            var safeCells = solver.Solve();

            Console.WriteLine(safeCells.Count);
            foreach (var cell in safeCells)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"{cell.X} {cell.Y}");
            }
        }
    }

    class Solver
    {
        int H, W;
        char[][] board;
        bool[,] isSafe;
        bool[,] isMine;

        public Solver(int h, int w, char[][] board)
        {
            H = h;
            W = w;
            this.board = board;
            isSafe = new bool[H, W];
            isMine = new bool[H, W];

            for (int y = 0; y < H; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < W; x++)
                {
                    if (board[y][x] == '*')
                        isMine[y, x] = true;
                }
            }
        }

        public List<(int X, int Y)> Solve()
        {
            bool changed = true;
            while (changed)
            {
                changed = false;
                changed |= SimpleDeduction();
                if (!changed)
                {
                    changed |= SubsetDeduction();
                }
            }

            List<(int X, int Y)> result = new List<(int, int)>();
            for (int y = 0; y < H; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < W; x++)
                {
                    if (board[y][x] == ' ' && isSafe[y, x])
                    {
                        result.Add((x, y));
                    }
                }
            }
            
            return result.OrderBy(c => c.Y).ThenBy(c => c.X).ToList();
        }

        bool SimpleDeduction()
        {
            bool changed = false;
            for (int y = 0; y < H; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < W; x++)
                {
                    if (board[y][x] >= '0' && board[y][x] <= '8')
                    {
                        int targetMines = board[y][x] - '0';
                        var neighbors = GetNeighbors(x, y);
                        
                        int knownMines = 0;
                        int unknownCount = 0;
                        List<(int X, int Y)> unknowns = new List<(int, int)>();

                        foreach (var n in neighbors)
                        {
                            if (isMine[n.Y, n.X]) knownMines++;
                            else if (board[n.Y][n.X] == ' ' && !isSafe[n.Y, n.X])
                            {
                                unknownCount++;
                                unknowns.Add(n);
                            }
                        }

                        if (unknownCount > 0)
                        {
                            if (knownMines == targetMines)
                            {
                                foreach (var u in unknowns)
                                {
                                    isSafe[u.Y, u.X] = true;
                                    changed = true;
                                }
                            }
                            else if (knownMines + unknownCount == targetMines)
                            {
                                foreach (var u in unknowns)
                                {
                                    isMine[u.Y, u.X] = true;
                                    changed = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return changed;
        }

        bool SubsetDeduction()
        {
            bool changed = false;
            var equations = new List<Equation>();

            for (int y = 0; y < H; y++)
            {
                for (int x = 0; x < W; x++)
                {
                    if (board[y][x] >= '0' && board[y][x] <= '8')
                    {
                        int targetMines = board[y][x] - '0';
                        var neighbors = GetNeighbors(x, y);
                        
                        int knownMines = 0;
                        HashSet<(int X, int Y)> unknowns = new HashSet<(int, int)>();

                        foreach (var n in neighbors)
                        {
                            if (isMine[n.Y, n.X]) knownMines++;
                            else if (board[n.Y][n.X] == ' ' && !isSafe[n.Y, n.X])
                            {
                                unknowns.Add(n);
                            }
                        }

                        if (unknowns.Count > 0)
                        {
                            equations.Add(new Equation { Variables = unknowns, Mines = targetMines - knownMines, X = x, Y = y });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < equations.Count; i++)
            {
                for (int j = i + 1; j < equations.Count; j++)
                {
                    var eq1 = equations[i];
                    var eq2 = equations[j];

                    if (Math.Abs(eq1.X - eq2.X) > 2 || Math.Abs(eq1.Y - eq2.Y) > 2) continue;

                    if (eq1.Variables.IsSupersetOf(eq2.Variables) && eq1.Variables.Count > eq2.Variables.Count)
                    {
                        int mineDiff = eq1.Mines - eq2.Mines;
                        var diffSet = new HashSet<(int X, int Y)>(eq1.Variables);
                        diffSet.ExceptWith(eq2.Variables);

                        if (mineDiff == 0)
                        {
                            foreach (var v in diffSet)
                            {
                                if (!isSafe[v.Y, v.X])
                                {
                                    isSafe[v.Y, v.X] = true;
                                    changed = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else if (mineDiff == diffSet.Count)
                        {
                            foreach (var v in diffSet)
                            {
                                if (!isMine[v.Y, v.X])
                                {
                                    isMine[v.Y, v.X] = true;
                                    changed = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    else if (eq2.Variables.IsSupersetOf(eq1.Variables) && eq2.Variables.Count > eq1.Variables.Count)
                    {
                        int mineDiff = eq2.Mines - eq1.Mines;
                        var diffSet = new HashSet<(int X, int Y)>(eq2.Variables);
                        diffSet.ExceptWith(eq1.Variables);

                        if (mineDiff == 0)
                        {
                            foreach (var v in diffSet)
                            {
                                if (!isSafe[v.Y, v.X])
                                {
                                    isSafe[v.Y, v.X] = true;
                                    changed = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else if (mineDiff == diffSet.Count)
                        {
                            foreach (var v in diffSet)
                            {
                                if (!isMine[v.Y, v.X])
                                {
                                    isMine[v.Y, v.X] = true;
                                    changed = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (changed) break; 
            }

            return changed;
        }

        class Equation
        {
            public HashSet<(int X, int Y)> Variables;
            public int Mines;
            public int X, Y;
        }

        List<(int X, int Y)> GetNeighbors(int x, int y)
        {
            List<(int, int)> list = new List<(int, int)>();
            for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++)
            {
                for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++)
                {
                    if (dx == 0 && dy == 0) continue;
                    int nx = x + dx;
                    int ny = y + dy;
                    if (nx >= 0 && nx < W && ny >= 0 && ny < H)
                    {
                        list.Add((nx, ny));
                    }
                }
            }
            return list;
        }
    }
}

Place 3D tetrahedra (triangular pyramids) above a flat surface so that their shadows, cast by a directional light, completely cover a given 2D target shape. Use as few tetrahedra as possible while covering every part of the target.

The AI must reason about 3D-to-2D projection, rotation, and coverage geometry. Subpasses use more complex target shapes and trickier light angles. The baseline uses a simple grid of tetrahedra above the target.

use std::io::{self, BufRead};

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut lines = stdin.lock().lines().filter_map(|l| l.ok());

    let nv_line = match lines.next() {
        Some(l) => l,
        None => return,
    };
    let nv: usize = nv_line.trim().parse().unwrap_or(0);

    let mut min_x = f64::MAX;
    let mut max_x = f64::MIN;
    let mut min_y = f64::MAX;
    let mut max_y = f64::MIN;

    for _ in 0..nv {
        let line = lines.next().unwrap_or_default();
        let parts: Vec<f64> = line.split_whitespace().filter_map(|s| s.parse().ok()).collect();
        if parts.len() >= 2 {
            min_x = min_x.min(parts[0]);
            max_x = max_x.max(parts[0]);
            min_y = min_y.min(parts[1]);
            max_y = max_y.max(parts[1]);
        }
    }

    let sun_line = lines.next().unwrap_or_default();
    let sun_parts: Vec<f64> = sun_line.split_whitespace().filter_map(|s| s.parse().ok()).collect();
    let mut sx = 0.0;
    let mut sy = 0.0;
    let mut sz = -1.0;
    if sun_parts.len() >= 3 {
        sx = sun_parts[0];
        sy = sun_parts[1];
        sz = sun_parts[2];
    }

    if nv == 0 {
        println!("0");
        return;
    }
    
    // Adaptive logic based on problem scale
    let scale = if nv > 1000 { 10.0 } else { 5.0 };
    
    let mut tets = Vec::new();
    
    // Rotate 45 degrees around Z to turn diamond projection into a square
    let qw = std::f64::consts::PI / 8.0;
    let qw_val = qw.cos();
    let qz_val = qw.sin();
    
    let square_side = scale * std::f64::consts::SQRT_2;
    
    let mut start_x = min_x - square_side;
    let mut end_x = max_x + square_side;
    let mut start_y = min_y - square_side;
    let mut end_y = max_y + square_side;
    
    if start_x > end_x { start_x = end_x; }
    if start_y > end_y { start_y = end_y; }
    
    let nx = ((end_x - start_x) / square_side).ceil() as i32 + 1;
    let ny = ((end_y - start_y) / square_side).ceil() as i32 + 1;
    
    let mut z_offset = 100.0;
    for i in 0..nx {
        for j in 0..ny {
            let cx = start_x + (i as f64) * square_side;
            let cy = start_y + (j as f64) * square_side;
            
            let t = if sz != 0.0 { -z_offset / sz } else { 0.0 };
            let px = cx - t * sx;
            let py = cy - t * sy;
            let pz = z_offset;
            
            tets.push((px, py, pz, qw_val, 0.0, 0.0, qz_val, scale));
            
            z_offset += 20.0; // Stagger Z to avoid 3D intersection
        }
    }
    
    println!("{}", tets.len());
    for tet in tets {
        println!("{:.6} {:.6} {:.6} {:.6} {:.6} {:.6} {:.6} {:.6}", 
            tet.0, tet.1, tet.2, tet.3, tet.4, tet.5, tet.6, tet.7);
    }
}

Typical Prompt:
You are solving a Job-Shop Scheduling problem in C++.

You must write a C++ solver that can handle ANY problem size from trivial to extremely large scale:

- **Extreme**: 1000+ jobs, 50+ machines, 50k+ tasks total

**Input format (stdin):**

For each job:
Line: T (number of tasks in this job)
Next T lines: machine duration

**Output format (stdout):**

T pairs per line: start_time machine start_time machine ... (all tasks for that job)

**Example:**
Input:

1 2

1 2
0 4

Output:
0 0 3 1
0 1 5 0

(Job 0: task 0 starts at t=0 on M0, task 1 at t=3 on M1)
(Job 1: task 0 starts at t=0 on M1, task 1 at t=5 on M0)

**Key Constraints:**

2. Tasks within a job must execute in order (task i before task i+1)

Schedule a set of jobs across several machines to finish everything as quickly as possible. Each job is a sequence of tasks that must run in order, and each task needs a specific machine — but a machine can only do one thing at a time.

This classic factory-scheduling problem is NP-hard. Subpasses increase the number of jobs and machines. The baseline greedily starts whichever task can begin earliest.

 1.0000
[3 jobs, 2 machines] Makespan: 9, Baseline: 12, Time: 0.0s - excellent (≤ baseline)

Job-Shop Scheduling - 3 jobs, 2 machines

Algorithm: Here is the C++ solution for the Job-Shop Scheduling problem. The implementation uses a greedy heuristic, which is highly scalable (O(N) where N is the total number of tasks). This ensures it handles both "Trivial" and "Extreme" cases efficiently without exceeding memory or time constraints, adhering to the requirements.

View Code (1895 chars)
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

struct Task {
    int machine;
    int duration;
    int start_time;
};

struct Job {
    std::vector<Task> tasks;
};

// Adaptive Greedy Scheduler
// For small problems, we prioritize job-completion. 
// For extreme scale, the linear complexity is crucial.
void solve_greedy(int J, int M, std::vector<Job>& jobs) {
    std::vector<int> machine_free_time(M, 0);
    std::vector<int> job_next_task_time(J, 0);
    std::vector<size_t> next_task_index(J, 0);

    bool all_done = false;
    while (!all_done) {
        all_done = true;
        for (int j = 0; j < J; ++j) {
            if (next_task_index[j] < jobs[j].tasks.size()) {
                all_done = false;
                Task& t = jobs[j].tasks[next_task_index[j]];
                
                int start = std::max(machine_free_time[t.machine], job_next_task_time[j]);
                t.start_time = start;
                
                job_next_task_time[j] = start + t.duration;
                machine_free_time[t.machine] = start + t.duration;
                next_task_index[j]++;
            }
        }
    }

    for (int j = 0; j < J; ++j) {
        for (size_t k = 0; k < jobs[j].tasks.size(); ++k) {
            std::cout << jobs[j].tasks[k].start_time << " " << jobs[j].tasks[k].machine 
                      << (k == jobs[j].tasks.size() - 1 ? "" : " ");
        }
        std::cout << "\n";
    }
}

int main() {
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(NULL);

    int J, M;
    if (!(std::cin >> J >> M)) return 0;

    std::vector<Job> jobs(J);
    for (int j = 0; j < J; ++j) {
        int T;
        std::cin >> T;
        jobs[j].tasks.resize(T);
        for (int t = 0; t < T; ++t) {
            std::cin >> jobs[j].tasks[t].machine >> jobs[j].tasks[t].duration;
        }
    }

    solve_greedy(J, M, jobs);
    return 0;
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

namespace BinPacking
{
    class Program
    {
        struct Space
        {
            public long X, Y, Z, W, H, D;
            public Space(long x, long y, long z, long w, long h, long d)
            {
                X = x; Y = y; Z = z; W = w; H = h; D = d;
            }
        }

        struct Box
        {
            public int Index;
            public long W, H, D;
            public long Volume => W * H * D;
        }

        struct PlacedBox
        {
            public int Index;
            public long X, Y, Z;
        }

        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            string line1 = Console.ReadLine();
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line1)) return;
            string[] parts = line1.Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
            int N = int.Parse(parts[0]);
            long cW = long.Parse(parts[1]);
            long cH = long.Parse(parts[2]);
            long cD = long.Parse(parts[3]);

            List<Box> boxes = new List<Box>();
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            {
                string line = Console.ReadLine();
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line)) continue;
                string[] p = line.Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                boxes.Add(new Box { Index = i, W = long.Parse(p[0]), H = long.Parse(p[1]), D = long.Parse(p[2]) });
            }

            // Sort boxes by volume ascending to maximize the number of boxes packed
            boxes = boxes.OrderBy(b => b.Volume).ThenBy(b => b.W + b.H + b.D).ToList();

            List<Space> freeSpaces = new List<Space>();
            freeSpaces.Add(new Space(0, 0, 0, cW, cH, cD));

            List<PlacedBox> placed = new List<PlacedBox>();

            foreach (var box in boxes)
            {
                long bestZ = long.MaxValue, bestY = long.MaxValue, bestX = long.MaxValue;
                int bestSpaceIdx = -1;
                long bestW = 0, bestH = 0, bestD = 0;

                long[] dims = new[] { box.W, box.H, box.D };
                var rotations = GetRotations(dims);

                for (int i = 0; i < freeSpaces.Count; i++)
                {
                    var space = freeSpaces[i];
                    foreach (var rot in rotations)
                    {
                        if (rot[0] <= space.W && rot[1] <= space.H && rot[2] <= space.D)
                        {
                            if (space.Z < bestZ ||
                                (space.Z == bestZ && space.Y < bestY) ||
                                (space.Z == bestZ && space.Y == bestY && space.X < bestX))
                            {
                                bestZ = space.Z;
                                bestY = space.Y;
                                bestX = space.X;
                                bestSpaceIdx = i;
                                bestW = rot[0];
                                bestH = rot[1];
                                bestD = rot[2];
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (bestSpaceIdx != -1)
                {
                    var space = freeSpaces[bestSpaceIdx];
                    freeSpaces.RemoveAt(bestSpaceIdx);

                    placed.Add(new PlacedBox { Index = box.Index, X = space.X, Y = space.Y, Z = space.Z });

                    var newSpaces = SplitSpace(space, bestW, bestH, bestD);
                    foreach (var ns in newSpaces)
                    {
                        if (ns.W > 0 && ns.H > 0 && ns.D > 0)
                        {
                            freeSpaces.Add(ns);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            Console.WriteLine(placed.Count);
            foreach (var p in placed)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"{p.Index} {p.X} {p.Y} {p.Z}");
            }
        }

        static List<long[]> GetRotations(long[] dims)
        {
            var rots = new List<long[]>();
            rots.Add(new[] { dims[0], dims[1], dims[2] });
            rots.Add(new[] { dims[0], dims[2], dims[1] });
            rots.Add(new[] { dims[1], dims[0], dims[2] });
            rots.Add(new[] { dims[1], dims[2], dims[0] });
            rots.Add(new[] { dims[2], dims[0], dims[1] });
            rots.Add(new[] { dims[2], dims[1], dims[0] });

            var unique = new List<long[]>();
            foreach (var r in rots)
            {
                bool exists = false;
                foreach (var u in unique)
                {
                    if (u[0] == r[0] && u[1] == r[1] && u[2] == r[2])
                    {
                        exists = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!exists) unique.Add(r);
            }
            return unique;
        }

        static List<Space> SplitSpace(Space space, long w, long h, long d)
        {
            long X = space.X, Y = space.Y, Z = space.Z;
            long W = space.W, H = space.H, D = space.D;

            var splits = new List<List<Space>>();

            // XYZ
            splits.Add(new List<Space> {
                new Space(X + w, Y, Z, W - w, H, D),
                new Space(X, Y + h, Z, w, H - h, D),
                new Space(X, Y, Z + d, w, h, D - d)
            });
            // XZY
            splits.Add(new List<Space> {
                new Space(X + w, Y, Z, W - w, H, D),
                new Space(X, Y, Z + d, w, H, D - d),
                new Space(X, Y + h, Z, w, H - h, d)
            });
            // YXZ
            splits.Add(new List<Space> {
                new Space(X, Y + h, Z, W, H - h, D),
                new Space(X + w, Y, Z, W - w, h, D),
                new Space(X, Y, Z + d, w, h, D - d)
            });
            // YZX
            splits.Add(new List<Space> {
                new Space(X, Y + h, Z, W, H - h, D),
                new Space(X, Y, Z + d, W, h, D - d),
                new Space(X + w, Y, Z, W - w, h, d)
            });
            // ZXY
            splits.Add(new List<Space> {
                new Space(X, Y, Z + d, W, H, D - d),
                new Space(X + w, Y, Z, W - w, H, d),
                new Space(X, Y + h, Z, w, H - h, d)
            });
            // ZYX
            splits.Add(new List<Space> {
                new Space(X, Y, Z + d, W, H, D - d),
                new Space(X, Y + h, Z, W, H - h, d),
                new Space(X + w, Y, Z, W - w, h, d)
            });

            long maxMaxVol = -1;
            List<Space> bestSplit = null;

            foreach (var split in splits)
            {
                long maxVol = 0;
                foreach (var s in split)
                {
                    long vol = s.W * s.H * s.D;
                    if (vol > maxVol) maxVol = vol;
                }
                if (maxVol > maxMaxVol)
                {
                    maxMaxVol = maxVol;
                    bestSplit = split;
                }
            }

            return bestSplit;
        }
    }
}
