using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

class Program
{
    static int numVertices;
    static int[] degrees;
    static int[][] adj;
    static HashSet<int>[] adjSet;

    static int[] bestClique;
    static int maxCliqueSize = 0;
    static object lockObj = new object();

    static void Main()
    {
        var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        
        using (Stream stream = Console.OpenStandardInput())
        {
            FastScanner scanner = new FastScanner(stream);
            int vCount = scanner.NextInt();
            int eCount = scanner.NextInt();
            
            if (vCount == -1) return;
            
            numVertices = vCount;
            int numEdges = eCount;

            degrees = new int[numVertices];
            List<int>[] tempAdj = new List<int>[numVertices];
            for (int i = 0; i < numVertices; i++) tempAdj[i] = new List<int>();

            for (int i = 0; i < numEdges; i++)
            {
                int u = scanner.NextInt();
                int v = scanner.NextInt();
                if (u == -1 || v == -1) break;
                
                if (u != v)
                {
                    tempAdj[u].Add(v);
                    tempAdj[v].Add(u);
                    degrees[u]++;
                    degrees[v]++;
                }
            }

            adj = new int[numVertices][];
            adjSet = new HashSet<int>[numVertices];
            for (int i = 0; i < numVertices; i++)
            {
                adj[i] = tempAdj[i].ToArray();
                adjSet[i] = new HashSet<int>(adj[i]);
            }
        }

        int[] initialClique = GreedyClique();
        bestClique = initialClique;
        maxCliqueSize = initialClique.Length;

        if (maxCliqueSize == numVertices || sw.ElapsedMilliseconds > 280000)
        {
            PrintResult();
            return;
        }

        int timeLimitMs = 280000; // 4.6 minutes
        int[] sortedVertices = Enumerable.Range(0, numVertices).OrderByDescending(v => degrees[v]).ToArray();

        Parallel.For(0, Environment.ProcessorCount, new ParallelOptions { MaxDegreeOfParallelism = Environment.ProcessorCount }, (threadId, state) =>
        {
            Random rand = new Random(threadId + Environment.TickCount);
            
            while (sw.ElapsedMilliseconds < timeLimitMs)
            {
                List<int> currentClique = new List<int>();
                List<int> candidates = new List<int>();
                
                int topK = Math.Max(1, Math.Min(100, numVertices / 10));
                int startVertex = sortedVertices[rand.Next(topK)];
                currentClique.Add(startVertex);
                candidates.AddRange(adj[startVertex]);

                while (candidates.Count > 0 && sw.ElapsedMilliseconds < timeLimitMs)
                {
                    int pickIdx = rand.Next(candidates.Count);
                    int u = candidates[pickIdx];
                    
                    currentClique.Add(u);
                    
                    List<int> nextCandidates = new List<int>(candidates.Count);
                    foreach (int c in candidates)
                    {
                        if (c != u && adjSet[u].Contains(c))
                        {
                            nextCandidates.Add(c);
                        }
                    }
                    candidates = nextCandidates;
                }

                if (currentClique.Count > maxCliqueSize)
                {
                    lock (lockObj)
                    {
                        if (currentClique.Count > maxCliqueSize)
                        {
                            maxCliqueSize = currentClique.Count;
                            bestClique = currentClique.ToArray();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        PrintResult();
    }

    static int[] GreedyClique()
    {
        List<int> clique = new List<int>();
        int[] sortedByDegree = Enumerable.Range(0, numVertices).OrderByDescending(v => degrees[v]).ToArray();
        
        foreach (int v in sortedByDegree)
        {
            bool canAdd = true;
            foreach (int c in clique)
            {
                if (!adjSet[v].Contains(c))
                {
                    canAdd = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (canAdd)
            {
                clique.Add(v);
            }
        }
        return clique.ToArray();
    }

    static void PrintResult()
    {
        Console.WriteLine(maxCliqueSize);
        Console.WriteLine(string.Join(" ", bestClique));
    }

    class FastScanner
    {
        private Stream stream;
        private byte[] buffer = new byte[1024 * 64];
        private int head;
        private int tail;

        public FastScanner(Stream stream)
        {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        public int NextInt()
        {
            int c = Read();
            while (c <= 32)
            {
                if (c == -1) return -1;
                c = Read();
            }

            int res = 0;
            while (c > 32)
            {
                if (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
                {
                    res = res * 10 + c - '0';
                }
                c = Read();
            }
            return res;
        }

        private int Read()
        {
            if (head >= tail)
            {
                head = 0;
                tail = stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
                if (tail <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[head++];
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

class Program
{
    static int numVertices;
    static int[] degrees;
    static int[][] adj;
    static HashSet<int>[] adjSet;

    static int[] bestClique;
    static int maxCliqueSize = 0;
    static object lockObj = new object();

    static void Main()
    {
        var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        
        using (Stream stream = Console.OpenStandardInput())
        {
            FastScanner scanner = new FastScanner(stream);
            int vCount = scanner.NextInt();
            int eCount = scanner.NextInt();
            
            if (vCount == -1) return;
            
            numVertices = vCount;
            int numEdges = eCount;

            degrees = new int[numVertices];
            List<int>[] tempAdj = new List<int>[numVertices];
            for (int i = 0; i < numVertices; i++) tempAdj[i] = new List<int>();

            for (int i = 0; i < numEdges; i++)
            {
                int u = scanner.NextInt();
                int v = scanner.NextInt();
                if (u == -1 || v == -1) break;
                
                if (u != v)
                {
                    tempAdj[u].Add(v);
                    tempAdj[v].Add(u);
                    degrees[u]++;
                    degrees[v]++;
                }
            }

            adj = new int[numVertices][];
            adjSet = new HashSet<int>[numVertices];
            for (int i = 0; i < numVertices; i++)
            {
                adj[i] = tempAdj[i].ToArray();
                adjSet[i] = new HashSet<int>(adj[i]);
            }
        }

        int[] initialClique = GreedyClique();
        bestClique = initialClique;
        maxCliqueSize = initialClique.Length;

        if (maxCliqueSize == numVertices || sw.ElapsedMilliseconds > 280000)
        {
            PrintResult();
            return;
        }

        int timeLimitMs = 280000; // 4.6 minutes
        int[] sortedVertices = Enumerable.Range(0, numVertices).OrderByDescending(v => degrees[v]).ToArray();

        Parallel.For(0, Environment.ProcessorCount, new ParallelOptions { MaxDegreeOfParallelism = Environment.ProcessorCount }, (threadId, state) =>
        {
            Random rand = new Random(threadId + Environment.TickCount);
            
            while (sw.ElapsedMilliseconds < timeLimitMs)
            {
                List<int> currentClique = new List<int>();
                List<int> candidates = new List<int>();
                
                int topK = Math.Max(1, Math.Min(100, numVertices / 10));
                int startVertex = sortedVertices[rand.Next(topK)];
                currentClique.Add(startVertex);
                candidates.AddRange(adj[startVertex]);

                while (candidates.Count > 0 && sw.ElapsedMilliseconds < timeLimitMs)
                {
                    int pickIdx = rand.Next(candidates.Count);
                    int u = candidates[pickIdx];
                    
                    currentClique.Add(u);
                    
                    List<int> nextCandidates = new List<int>(candidates.Count);
                    foreach (int c in candidates)
                    {
                        if (c != u && adjSet[u].Contains(c))
                        {
                            nextCandidates.Add(c);
                        }
                    }
                    candidates = nextCandidates;
                }

                if (currentClique.Count > maxCliqueSize)
                {
                    lock (lockObj)
                    {
                        if (currentClique.Count > maxCliqueSize)
                        {
                            maxCliqueSize = currentClique.Count;
                            bestClique = currentClique.ToArray();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        PrintResult();
    }

    static int[] GreedyClique()
    {
        List<int> clique = new List<int>();
        int[] sortedByDegree = Enumerable.Range(0, numVertices).OrderByDescending(v => degrees[v]).ToArray();
        
        foreach (int v in sortedByDegree)
        {
            bool canAdd = true;
            foreach (int c in clique)
            {
                if (!adjSet[v].Contains(c))
                {
                    canAdd = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (canAdd)
            {
                clique.Add(v);
            }
        }
        return clique.ToArray();
    }

    static void PrintResult()
    {
        Console.WriteLine(maxCliqueSize);
        Console.WriteLine(string.Join(" ", bestClique));
    }

    class FastScanner
    {
        private Stream stream;
        private byte[] buffer = new byte[1024 * 64];
        private int head;
        private int tail;

        public FastScanner(Stream stream)
        {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        public int NextInt()
        {
            int c = Read();
            while (c <= 32)
            {
                if (c == -1) return -1;
                c = Read();
            }

            int res = 0;
            while (c > 32)
            {
                if (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
                {
                    res = res * 10 + c - '0';
                }
                c = Read();
            }
            return res;
        }

        private int Read()
        {
            if (head >= tail)
            {
                head = 0;
                tail = stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
                if (tail <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[head++];
        }
    }
}

Typical Prompt:
You are writing Python code to solve the 3-SAT (Boolean Satisfiability) problem, which is NP-Complete.

**What is 3-SAT?**
You have N boolean variables (x1, x2, ..., xN), each of which is either True or False.
You are given M "clauses". Each clause is a constraint containing exactly 3 "literals".
A literal is either:
- A positive integer (e.g. 5) meaning "variable 5 must be True", or
- A negative integer (e.g. -5) meaning "variable 5 must be False".

A clause is **satisfied** if ANY of its 3 literals evaluates to True.
The formula is **satisfiable** if ALL clauses can be satisfied simultaneously
by some assignment of True/False to the variables.

**Example:**
Variables: x1, x2, x3
Clause "1 -2 3" means: x1=True OR x2=False OR x3=True.
If x1=True, x2=True, x3=False → clause satisfied (x1=True is enough).

Your task: find an assignment of True/False to every variable that satisfies
every clause. All test instances are guaranteed to be satisfiable.

**Input format (stdin):**
```
num_variables num_clauses
lit1 lit2 lit3
lit1 lit2 lit3
...
```
Variables are 1-indexed. Negative literals mean negation.

**Output format (stdout):**
```
SAT
v1 v2 v3 ... vN
```
Where each vi is 1 (True) or 0 (False) for variable i, space-separated.

**Grading:**
- Output "SAT" on the first line, then the assignment on the second line.
- Every clause must be satisfied by your assignment.
- Timeouts, crashes, wrong format, or unsatisfied clauses all score 0.

**Requirements:**
1. Read from stdin, write to stdout.
2. Handle up to 20M variables and 85M clauses.
3. Complete within 5 minutes.

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <numeric>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const long long INF = 1e18;

struct Edge {
    int to;
    long long weight;
    int id;
};

struct EdgeData {
    int u, v;
    long long weight;
    int id;
};

struct GPrimeEdge {
    int u_term;
    int v_term;
    long long weight;
    int original_u;
    int original_v;
    int original_edge_id;
};

struct DSU {
    vector<int> parent;
    DSU(int n) {
        parent.resize(n);
        iota(parent.begin(), parent.end(), 0);
    }
    int find(int i) {
        if (parent[i] == i)
            return i;
        return parent[i] = find(parent[i]);
    }
    bool unite(int i, int j) {
        int root_i = find(i);
        int root_j = find(j);
        if (root_i != root_j) {
            parent[root_i] = root_j;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int V, E, K;
    if (!(cin >> V >> E >> K)) return 0;

    vector<EdgeData> edges(E);
    vector<vector<Edge>> adj(V);

    for (int i = 0; i < E; ++i) {
        cin >> edges[i].u >> edges[i].v >> edges[i].weight;
        edges[i].id = i;
        adj[edges[i].u].push_back({edges[i].v, edges[i].weight, i});
        adj[edges[i].v].push_back({edges[i].u, edges[i].weight, i});
    }

    vector<int> terminals(K);
    vector<bool> is_terminal(V, false);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        cin >> terminals[i];
        is_terminal[terminals[i]] = true;
    }

    if (K <= 1) {
        cout << "0 0\n";
        return 0;
    }

    bool use_exact = false;
    if (K <= 15) {
        long long p3 = 1;
        for(int i=0; i<K; ++i) p3 *= 3;
        long long op1 = p3 * V;
        long long op2 = (1LL << K) * (V * 20LL + E);
        long long states = (1LL << K) * V;
        if (states <= 5000000 && op1 + op2 <= 100000000) {
            use_exact = true;
        }
    }

    vector<int> final_edges;

    if (use_exact) {
        vector<long long> dp((1 << K) * V, INF);
        vector<int> parent_type((1 << K) * V, 0);
        vector<int> parent_info((1 << K) * V, 0);
        vector<int> parent_edge_arr((1 << K) * V, -1);

        for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
            dp[(1 << i) * V + terminals[i]] = 0;
        }

        for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << K); ++mask) {
            if ((mask & (mask - 1)) != 0) { 
                int lowest_bit = mask & -mask;
                for (int submask = (mask - 1) & mask; submask > 0; submask = (submask - 1) & mask) {
                    if ((submask & lowest_bit) == 0) continue;
                    int other = mask ^ submask;
                    
                    const long long* dp_sub = &dp[submask * V];
                    const long long* dp_oth = &dp[other * V];
                    long long* dp_msk = &dp[mask * V];
                    int* ptype_msk = &parent_type[mask * V];
                    int* pinfo_msk = &parent_info[mask * V];

                    for (int v = 0; v < V; ++v) {
                        long long cost = dp_sub[v] + dp_oth[v];
                        if (cost < dp_msk[v]) {
                            dp_msk[v] = cost;
                            ptype_msk[v] = 1;
                            pinfo_msk[v] = submask;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            priority_queue<pair<long long, int>, vector<pair<long long, int>>, greater<pair<long long, int>>> pq;
            long long* dp_msk = &dp[mask * V];
            int* ptype_msk = &parent_type[mask * V];
            int* pinfo_msk = &parent_info[mask * V];

            if (ptype == 1) {

        vector<bool> subgraph_edges(E, false);

struct Edge {

struct EdgeData {

};

struct GPrimeEdge {
    int u_term;
    int v_term;
    long long weight;
    int original_u;
    int original_v;
    int original_edge_id;
};

struct DSU {
    vector<int> parent;
    DSU(int n) {
        parent.resize(n);
        iota(parent.begin(), parent.end(), 0);
    }
    int find(int i) {
        if (parent[i] == i)
            return i;
        return parent[i] = find(parent[i]);
    }
    bool unite(int i, int j) {
        int root_i = find(i);
        int root_j = find(j);
        if (root_i != root_j) {
            parent[root_i] = root_j;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
};

        DSU dsu(V);
        vector<bool> subgraph_edges(E, false);
        int edges_added = 0;

        for (auto& gpe : gp_edges) {
            if (dsu.unite(gpe.u_term, gpe.v_term)) {

                int curr = gpe.original_u;
                while (parent_edge_arr[curr] != -1) {

            return a.weight < b.weight;
        });

        DSU dsu_H(V);
        vector<int> mst_edges;
        for (auto& edge : H_edges) {

            }
        }

        vector<vector<pair<int, int>>> mst_adj(V);
        vector<int> degree(V, 0);

        for (int e_id : mst_edges) {
            int u = edges[e_id].u;
            int v = edges[e_id].v;
            mst_adj[u].push_back({v, e_id});
            mst_adj[v].push_back({u, e_id});
            degree[u]++;
            degree[v]++;
        }

                    degree[v]--;
                    if (degree[v] == 1 && !is_terminal[v]) {

                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int e_id : mst_edges) {
            if (!pruned_edges[e_id]) {
                final_edges.push_back(e_id);
            }
        }
    }

    long long total_weight = 0;
    for (int e_id : final_edges) {
        total_weight += edges[e_id].weight;
    }

    for (int e_id : final_edges) {

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>

#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const long long INF = 1e18;

struct Edge {
    int to;
    long long weight;
    int id;
};

struct EdgeData {
    int u, v;
    long long weight;
    int id;
};

struct GPrimeEdge {
    int u_term;
    int v_term;
    long long weight;
    int original_u;
    int original_v;
    int original_edge_id;
};

struct DSU {
    vector<int> parent;
    DSU(int n) {
        parent.resize(n);
        iota(parent.begin(), parent.end(), 0);
    }
    int find(int i) {
        if (parent[i] == i)
            return i;
        return parent[i] = find(parent[i]);
    }
    bool unite(int i, int j) {
        int root_i = find(i);
        int root_j = find(j);
        if (root_i != root_j) {
            parent[root_i] = root_j;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
};

        cin >> edges[i].u >> edges[i].v >> edges[i].weight;
        edges[i].id = i;
        adj[edges[i].u].push_back({edges[i].v, edges[i].weight, i});
        adj[edges[i].v].push_back({edges[i].u, edges[i].weight, i});
    }

    vector<bool> is_terminal(V, false);

    }

    }

            mst_adj[v].push_back({u, e_id});
            degree[u]++;
            degree[v]++;
        }

        queue<int> leaves;
        for (int i = 0; i < V; ++i) {
            if (degree[i] == 1 && !is_terminal[i]) {

            }
        }

        while (!leaves.empty()) {
            int u = leaves.front();
            leaves.pop();

            for (auto& edge : mst_adj[u]) {
                int v = edge.first;
                int e_id = edge.second;
                if (!pruned_edges[e_id]) {

                    degree[u]--;
                    degree[v]--;
                    if (degree[v] == 1 && !is_terminal[v]) {
                        leaves.push(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int e_id : mst_edges) {
            if (!pruned_edges[e_id]) {
                final_edges.push_back(e_id);
            }
        }
    }

    long long total_weight = 0;
    for (int e_id : final_edges) {
        total_weight += edges[e_id].weight;
    }

    cout << total_weight << " " << final_edges.size() << "\n";

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <numeric>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const long long INF = 1e18;

struct Edge {
    int to;
    long long weight;
    int id;
};

struct EdgeData {
    int u, v;
    long long weight;
    int id;
};

struct GPrimeEdge {
    int u_term;
    int v_term;
    long long weight;
    int original_u;
    int original_v;
    int original_edge_id;
};

struct DSU {
    vector<int> parent;
    DSU(int n) {
        parent.resize(n);
        iota(parent.begin(), parent.end(), 0);
    }
    int find(int i) {
        if (parent[i] == i)
            return i;
        return parent[i] = find(parent[i]);
    }
    bool unite(int i, int j) {
        int root_i = find(i);
        int root_j = find(j);
        if (root_i != root_j) {
            parent[root_i] = root_j;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int V, E, K;
    if (!(cin >> V >> E >> K)) return 0;

    vector<EdgeData> edges(E);
    vector<vector<Edge>> adj(V);

    for (int i = 0; i < E; ++i) {
        cin >> edges[i].u >> edges[i].v >> edges[i].weight;
        edges[i].id = i;
        adj[edges[i].u].push_back({edges[i].v, edges[i].weight, i});
        adj[edges[i].v].push_back({edges[i].u, edges[i].weight, i});
    }

    vector<int> terminals(K);
    vector<bool> is_terminal(V, false);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        cin >> terminals[i];
        is_terminal[terminals[i]] = true;
    }

    if (K <= 1) {
        cout << "0 0\n";
        return 0;
    }

    bool use_exact = false;
    if (K <= 15) {
        long long p3 = 1;
        for(int i=0; i<K; ++i) p3 *= 3;
        long long op1 = p3 * V;
        long long op2 = (1LL << K) * (V * 20LL + E);
        long long states = (1LL << K) * V;
        if (states <= 5000000 && op1 + op2 <= 100000000) {
            use_exact = true;
        }
    }

    vector<int> final_edges;

    if (use_exact) {
        vector<long long> dp((1 << K) * V, INF);
        vector<int> parent_type((1 << K) * V, 0);
        vector<int> parent_info((1 << K) * V, 0);
        vector<int> parent_edge_arr((1 << K) * V, -1);

        for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
            dp[(1 << i) * V + terminals[i]] = 0;
        }

        for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << K); ++mask) {
            if ((mask & (mask - 1)) != 0) { 
                int lowest_bit = mask & -mask;
                for (int submask = (mask - 1) & mask; submask > 0; submask = (submask - 1) & mask) {
                    if ((submask & lowest_bit) == 0) continue;
                    int other = mask ^ submask;
                    
                    const long long* dp_sub = &dp[submask * V];
                    const long long* dp_oth = &dp[other * V];
                    long long* dp_msk = &dp[mask * V];
                    int* ptype_msk = &parent_type[mask * V];
                    int* pinfo_msk = &parent_info[mask * V];

                    for (int v = 0; v < V; ++v) {
                        long long cost = dp_sub[v] + dp_oth[v];
                        if (cost < dp_msk[v]) {
                            dp_msk[v] = cost;
                            ptype_msk[v] = 1;
                            pinfo_msk[v] = submask;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            priority_queue<pair<long long, int>, vector<pair<long long, int>>, greater<pair<long long, int>>> pq;
            long long* dp_msk = &dp[mask * V];
            int* ptype_msk = &parent_type[mask * V];
            int* pinfo_msk = &parent_info[mask * V];
            int* pedge_msk = &parent_edge_arr[mask * V];

            for (int v = 0; v < V; ++v) {
                if (dp_msk[v] != INF) {
                    pq.push({dp_msk[v], v});
                }
            }

            while (!pq.empty()) {
                auto [d, u] = pq.top();
                pq.pop();
                if (d > dp_msk[u]) continue;

                for (auto& edge : adj[u]) {
                    int v = edge.to;
                    if (dp_msk[v] > d + edge.weight) {
                        dp_msk[v] = d + edge.weight;
                        ptype_msk[v] = 2;
                        pinfo_msk[v] = u;
                        pedge_msk[v] = edge.id;
                        pq.push({dp_msk[v], v});
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long long best_cost = INF;
        int best_root = -1;
        int full_mask = (1 << K) - 1;
        for (int v = 0; v < V; ++v) {
            if (dp[full_mask * V + v] < best_cost) {
                best_cost = dp[full_mask * V + v];
                best_root = v;
            }
        }

        vector<bool> edge_used(E, false);
        queue<pair<int, int>> q;
        if (best_root != -1) {
            q.push({full_mask, best_root});
        }

        while (!q.empty()) {
            auto [mask, v] = q.front();
            q.pop();

            int ptype = parent_type[mask * V + v];
            if (ptype == 1) {
                int submask = parent_info[mask * V + v];
                int other = mask ^ submask;
                q.push({submask, v});
                q.push({other, v});
            } else if (ptype == 2) {
                int u = parent_info[mask * V + v];
                int e_id = parent_edge_arr[mask * V + v];
                if (!edge_used[e_id]) {
                    edge_used[e_id] = true;
                    final_edges.push_back(e_id);
                }
                q.push({mask, u});
            }
        }
    } else {
        vector<long long> dist(V, INF);
        vector<int> origin(V, -1);
        vector<int> parent_edge_arr(V, -1);
        vector<int> parent_node(V, -1);

        priority_queue<pair<long long, int>, vector<pair<long long, int>>, greater<pair<long long, int>>> pq;

        for (int t : terminals) {
            dist[t] = 0;
            origin[t] = t;
            pq.push({0, t});
        }

        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto [d, u] = pq.top();
            pq.pop();

            if (d > dist[u]) continue;

            for (auto& edge : adj[u]) {
                int v = edge.to;
                if (dist[v] > d + edge.weight) {
                    dist[v] = d + edge.weight;
                    origin[v] = origin[u];
                    parent_node[v] = u;
                    parent_edge_arr[v] = edge.id;
                    pq.push({dist[v], v});
                }
            }
        }

        vector<GPrimeEdge> gp_edges;
        for (int i = 0; i < E; ++i) {
            int u = edges[i].u;
            int v = edges[i].v;
            if (origin[u] != -1 && origin[v] != -1 && origin[u] != origin[v]) {
                long long w = dist[u] + dist[v] + edges[i].weight;
                gp_edges.push_back({origin[u], origin[v], w, u, v, i});
            }
        }

        sort(gp_edges.begin(), gp_edges.end(), [](const GPrimeEdge& a, const GPrimeEdge& b) {
            return a.weight < b.weight;
        });

        DSU dsu(V);
        vector<bool> subgraph_edges(E, false);
        int edges_added = 0;

        for (auto& gpe : gp_edges) {
            if (dsu.unite(gpe.u_term, gpe.v_term)) {
                subgraph_edges[gpe.original_edge_id] = true;

                while (parent_edge_arr[curr] != -1) {

                    curr = parent_node[curr];
                }
                
                curr = gpe.original_v;
                while (parent_edge_arr[curr] != -1) {
                    subgraph_edges[parent_edge_arr[curr]] = true;
                    curr = parent_node[curr];
                }
                
                edges_added++;
                if (edges_added == K - 1) break;
            }
        }

        vector<EdgeData> H_edges;
        for (int i = 0; i < E; ++i) {
            if (subgraph_edges[i]) {
                H_edges.push_back(edges[i]);
            }
        }

        sort(H_edges.begin(), H_edges.end(), [](const EdgeData& a, const EdgeData& b) {
            return a.weight < b.weight;
        });

        DSU dsu_H(V);
        vector<int> mst_edges;

        vector<int> degree(V, 0);

        for (int e_id : mst_edges) {

            mst_adj[v].push_back({u, e_id});

                int e_id = edge.second;
                if (!pruned_edges[e_id]) {
                    pruned_edges[e_id] = true;
                    degree[u]--;
                    degree[v]--;
                    if (degree[v] == 1 && !is_terminal[v]) {

                    }
                }
            }
        }

            }
        }
    }

    long long total_weight = 0;
    for (int e_id : final_edges) {

    }

    cout << total_weight << " " << final_edges.size() << "\n";
    for (int e_id : final_edges) {

    }

    return 0;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int V, E, K;
    if (!(cin >> V >> E >> K)) return 0;

    vector<EdgeData> edges(E);
    vector<vector<Edge>> adj(V);

    for (int i = 0; i < E; ++i) {
        cin >> edges[i].u >> edges[i].v >> edges[i].weight;
        edges[i].id = i;
        adj[edges[i].u].push_back({edges[i].v, edges[i].weight, i});
        adj[edges[i].v].push_back({edges[i].u, edges[i].weight, i});
    }

    vector<int> terminals(K);
    vector<bool> is_terminal(V, false);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        cin >> terminals[i];
        is_terminal[terminals[i]] = true;
    }

    if (K <= 1) {
        cout << "0 0\n";
        return 0;
    }

    bool use_exact = false;
    if (K <= 15) {
        long long p3 = 1;
        for(int i=0; i<K; ++i) p3 *= 3;
        long long op1 = p3 * V;
        long long op2 = (1LL << K) * (V * 20LL + E);
        long long states = (1LL << K) * V;
        if (states <= 5000000 && op1 + op2 <= 100000000) {
            use_exact = true;
        }
    }

    vector<int> final_edges;

    if (use_exact) {
        vector<long long> dp((1 << K) * V, INF);
        vector<int> parent_type((1 << K) * V, 0);
        vector<int> parent_info((1 << K) * V, 0);
        vector<int> parent_edge_arr((1 << K) * V, -1);

        for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
            dp[(1 << i) * V + terminals[i]] = 0;
        }

        for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << K); ++mask) {
            if ((mask & (mask - 1)) != 0) { 
                int lowest_bit = mask & -mask;
                for (int submask = (mask - 1) & mask; submask > 0; submask = (submask - 1) & mask) {
                    if ((submask & lowest_bit) == 0) continue;
                    int other = mask ^ submask;
                    
                    const long long* dp_sub = &dp[submask * V];
                    const long long* dp_oth = &dp[other * V];
                    long long* dp_msk = &dp[mask * V];
                    int* ptype_msk = &parent_type[mask * V];
                    int* pinfo_msk = &parent_info[mask * V];

                    for (int v = 0; v < V; ++v) {
                        long long cost = dp_sub[v] + dp_oth[v];
                        if (cost < dp_msk[v]) {
                            dp_msk[v] = cost;
                            ptype_msk[v] = 1;
                            pinfo_msk[v] = submask;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            priority_queue<pair<long long, int>, vector<pair<long long, int>>, greater<pair<long long, int>>> pq;
            long long* dp_msk = &dp[mask * V];
            int* ptype_msk = &parent_type[mask * V];
            int* pinfo_msk = &parent_info[mask * V];
            int* pedge_msk = &parent_edge_arr[mask * V];

            for (int v = 0; v < V; ++v) {
                if (dp_msk[v] != INF) {
                    pq.push({dp_msk[v], v});
                }
            }

            while (!pq.empty()) {
                auto [d, u] = pq.top();
                pq.pop();
                if (d > dp_msk[u]) continue;

                for (auto& edge : adj[u]) {
                    int v = edge.to;
                    if (dp_msk[v] > d + edge.weight) {
                        dp_msk[v] = d + edge.weight;
                        ptype_msk[v] = 2;
                        pinfo_msk[v] = u;
                        pedge_msk[v] = edge.id;
                        pq.push({dp_msk[v], v});
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long long best_cost = INF;
        int best_root = -1;
        int full_mask = (1 << K) - 1;
        for (int v = 0; v < V; ++v) {
            if (dp[full_mask * V + v] < best_cost) {
                best_cost = dp[full_mask * V + v];
                best_root = v;
            }
        }

        vector<bool> edge_used(E, false);
        queue<pair<int, int>> q;
        if (best_root != -1) {
            q.push({full_mask, best_root});
        }

        while (!q.empty()) {
            auto [mask, v] = q.front();
            q.pop();

            int ptype = parent_type[mask * V + v];
            if (ptype == 1) {
                int submask = parent_info[mask * V + v];
                int other = mask ^ submask;
                q.push({submask, v});
                q.push({other, v});
            } else if (ptype == 2) {
                int u = parent_info[mask * V + v];
                int e_id = parent_edge_arr[mask * V + v];
                if (!edge_used[e_id]) {
                    edge_used[e_id] = true;
                    final_edges.push_back(e_id);
                }
                q.push({mask, u});
            }
        }
    } else {
        vector<long long> dist(V, INF);
        vector<int> origin(V, -1);
        vector<int> parent_edge_arr(V, -1);
        vector<int> parent_node(V, -1);

        priority_queue<pair<long long, int>, vector<pair<long long, int>>, greater<pair<long long, int>>> pq;

        for (int t : terminals) {
            dist[t] = 0;
            origin[t] = t;
            pq.push({0, t});
        }

        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto [d, u] = pq.top();
            pq.pop();

            if (d > dist[u]) continue;

            for (auto& edge : adj[u]) {
                int v = edge.to;
                if (dist[v] > d + edge.weight) {
                    dist[v] = d + edge.weight;
                    origin[v] = origin[u];
                    parent_node[v] = u;
                    parent_edge_arr[v] = edge.id;
                    pq.push({dist[v], v});
                }
            }
        }

        vector<GPrimeEdge> gp_edges;
        for (int i = 0; i < E; ++i) {
            int u = edges[i].u;
            int v = edges[i].v;
            if (origin[u] != -1 && origin[v] != -1 && origin[u] != origin[v]) {
                long long w = dist[u] + dist[v] + edges[i].weight;
                gp_edges.push_back({origin[u], origin[v], w, u, v, i});
            }
        }

        sort(gp_edges.begin(), gp_edges.end(), [](const GPrimeEdge& a, const GPrimeEdge& b) {
            return a.weight < b.weight;
        });

        DSU dsu(V);
        vector<bool> subgraph_edges(E, false);
        int edges_added = 0;

        for (auto& gpe : gp_edges) {
            if (dsu.unite(gpe.u_term, gpe.v_term)) {
                subgraph_edges[gpe.original_edge_id] = true;
                
                int curr = gpe.original_u;
                while (parent_edge_arr[curr] != -1) {
                    subgraph_edges[parent_edge_arr[curr]] = true;
                    curr = parent_node[curr];
                }
                
                curr = gpe.original_v;
                while (parent_edge_arr[curr] != -1) {
                    subgraph_edges[parent_edge_arr[curr]] = true;
                    curr = parent_node[curr];
                }
                
                edges_added++;
                if (edges_added == K - 1) break;
            }
        }

        vector<EdgeData> H_edges;
        for (int i = 0; i < E; ++i) {
            if (subgraph_edges[i]) {
                H_edges.push_back(edges[i]);
            }
        }

        sort(H_edges.begin(), H_edges.end(), [](const EdgeData& a, const EdgeData& b) {
            return a.weight < b.weight;
        });

        DSU dsu_H(V);
        vector<int> mst_edges;
        for (auto& edge : H_edges) {
            if (dsu_H.unite(edge.u, edge.v)) {
                mst_edges.push_back(edge.id);
            }
        }

        vector<vector<pair<int, int>>> mst_adj(V);
        vector<int> degree(V, 0);

        for (int e_id : mst_edges) {
            int u = edges[e_id].u;
            int v = edges[e_id].v;
            mst_adj[u].push_back({v, e_id});
            mst_adj[v].push_back({u, e_id});
            degree[u]++;
            degree[v]++;
        }

        queue<int> leaves;
        for (int i = 0; i < V; ++i) {
            if (degree[i] == 1 && !is_terminal[i]) {
                leaves.push(i);
            }
        }

        vector<bool> pruned_edges(E, false);

        while (!leaves.empty()) {
            int u = leaves.front();
            leaves.pop();

            for (auto& edge : mst_adj[u]) {
                int v = edge.first;
                int e_id = edge.second;
                if (!pruned_edges[e_id]) {
                    pruned_edges[e_id] = true;
                    degree[u]--;
                    degree[v]--;
                    if (degree[v] == 1 && !is_terminal[v]) {
                        leaves.push(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int e_id : mst_edges) {
            if (!pruned_edges[e_id]) {
                final_edges.push_back(e_id);
            }
        }
    }

    long long total_weight = 0;
    for (int e_id : final_edges) {
        total_weight += edges[e_id].weight;
    }

    cout << total_weight << " " << final_edges.size() << "\n";
    for (int e_id : final_edges) {
        cout << edges[e_id].u << " " << edges[e_id].v << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

struct Edge {

struct EdgeData {
    int u, v;
    long long weight;
    int id;
};

struct GPrimeEdge {
    int u_term;
    int v_term;
    long long weight;
    int original_u;
    int original_v;
    int original_edge_id;
};

struct DSU {
    vector<int> parent;
    DSU(int n) {
        parent.resize(n);
        iota(parent.begin(), parent.end(), 0);
    }
    int find(int i) {
        if (parent[i] == i)
            return i;
        return parent[i] = find(parent[i]);
    }
    bool unite(int i, int j) {
        int root_i = find(i);
        int root_j = find(j);
        if (root_i != root_j) {
            parent[root_i] = root_j;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
};

            mst_adj[v].push_back({u, e_id});

                    degree[v]--;
                    if (degree[v] == 1 && !is_terminal[v]) {
                        leaves.push(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

            if (!pruned_edges[e_id]) {
                final_edges.push_back(e_id);
            }
        }
    }

    long long total_weight = 0;
    for (int e_id : final_edges) {
        total_weight += edges[e_id].weight;
    }

    cout << total_weight << " " << final_edges.size() << "\n";
    for (int e_id : final_edges) {
        cout << edges[e_id].u << " " << edges[e_id].v << "\n";
    }

}

struct GPrimeEdge {
    int u_term;
    int v_term;
    long long weight;
    int original_u;
    int original_v;
    int original_edge_id;
};

struct DSU {
    vector<int> parent;
    DSU(int n) {
        parent.resize(n);
        iota(parent.begin(), parent.end(), 0);
    }
    int find(int i) {
        if (parent[i] == i)
            return i;
        return parent[i] = find(parent[i]);
    }
    bool unite(int i, int j) {
        int root_i = find(i);
        int root_j = find(j);
        if (root_i != root_j) {
            parent[root_i] = root_j;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
};

    long long weight;
    int original_u;
    int original_v;
    int original_edge_id;
};

struct DSU {
    vector<int> parent;
    DSU(int n) {
        parent.resize(n);
        iota(parent.begin(), parent.end(), 0);
    }
    int find(int i) {
        if (parent[i] == i)
            return i;
        return parent[i] = find(parent[i]);
    }
    bool unite(int i, int j) {
        int root_i = find(i);
        int root_j = find(j);
        if (root_i != root_j) {
            parent[root_i] = root_j;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
};

            degree[v]++;
        }

        queue<int> leaves;
        for (int i = 0; i < V; ++i) {
            if (degree[i] == 1 && !is_terminal[i]) {
                leaves.push(i);
            }
        }

        vector<bool> pruned_edges(E, false);

        while (!leaves.empty()) {
            int u = leaves.front();
            leaves.pop();

            for (auto& edge : mst_adj[u]) {
                int v = edge.first;
                int e_id = edge.second;
                if (!pruned_edges[e_id]) {
                    pruned_edges[e_id] = true;
                    degree[u]--;
                    degree[v]--;
                    if (degree[v] == 1 && !is_terminal[v]) {
                        leaves.push(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int e_id : mst_edges) {
            if (!pruned_edges[e_id]) {
                final_edges.push_back(e_id);
            }
        }
    }

    long long total_weight = 0;
    for (int e_id : final_edges) {
        total_weight += edges[e_id].weight;
    }

    cout << total_weight << " " << final_edges.size() << "\n";
    for (int e_id : final_edges) {
        cout << edges[e_id].u << " " << edges[e_id].v << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Diagnostics;

class Program
{
    static void Main()
    {
        using (Stream stream = Console.OpenStandardInput())
        {
            Scanner scanner = new Scanner(stream);
            int N = scanner.NextInt();
            if (N <= 0) return;

            int[] flow = new int[N * N];
            for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++) flow[i] = scanner.NextInt();

            int[] dist = new int[N * N];
            for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++) dist[i] = scanner.NextInt();

            int[] p = new int[N];
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) p[i] = i;

            if (N == 1)
            {
                long c = CalculateCost(p, flow, dist, N);
                Console.WriteLine(c);
                Console.WriteLine("0");
                return;
            }

            Stopwatch sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
            Random rand = new Random(42);

            // Initial random shuffle
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            {
                int j = rand.Next(i, N);
                int temp = p[i]; p[i] = p[j]; p[j] = temp;
            }

            long currentCost = CalculateCost(p, flow, dist, N);
            long bestCost = currentCost;
            int[] bestP = (int[])p.Clone();

            double T = 1000000.0;
            double alpha = 0.9999;
            long iterations = 0;

            // Run for ~280 seconds (4.6 minutes) to stay well within 5 minutes
            while (sw.ElapsedMilliseconds < 280000)
            {
                int u = rand.Next(N);
                int v = rand.Next(N);
                if (u == v) continue;

                long delta = CalculateDelta(p, flow, dist, N, u, v);
                bool accept = false;

                if (delta < 0)
                {
                    accept = true;
                }
                else
                {
                    if (delta < T * 10) // Optimization to avoid Math.Exp for large negatives
                    {
                        if (rand.NextDouble() < Math.Exp(-delta / T))
                        {
                            accept = true;
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (accept)
                {
                    currentCost += delta;
                    int temp = p[u]; p[u] = p[v]; p[v] = temp;

                    if (currentCost < bestCost)
                    {
                        bestCost = currentCost;
                        Array.Copy(p, bestP, N);
                    }
                }

                iterations++;
                if (iterations % 10000 == 0)
                {
                    T *= alpha;
                    if (T < 1e-3) T = 1000000.0; // Reheat
                }
            }

            Console.WriteLine(bestCost);
            Console.WriteLine(string.Join(" ", bestP));
        }
    }

    static long CalculateCost(int[] p, int[] flow, int[] dist, int N)
    {
        long cost = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            int rowU = i * N;
            int rowPU = p[i] * N;
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++)
            {
                cost += (long)flow[rowU + j] * dist[rowPU + p[j]];
            }
        }
        return cost;
    }

    static long CalculateDelta(int[] p, int[] flow, int[] dist, int N, int u, int v)
    {
        long delta = 0;
        int pu = p[u];
        int pv = p[v];

        int rowU = u * N;
        int rowV = v * N;
        int rowPU = pu * N;
        int rowPV = pv * N;

        for (int k = 0; k < N; k++)
        {
            if (k == u || k == v) continue;
            
            int pk = p[k];
            int rowK = k * N;
            int rowPK = pk * N;

            delta += (long)flow[rowU + k] * (dist[rowPV + pk] - dist[rowPU + pk])
                   + (long)flow[rowK + u] * (dist[rowPK + pv] - dist[rowPK + pu])
                   + (long)flow[rowV + k] * (dist[rowPU + pk] - dist[rowPV + pk])
                   + (long)flow[rowK + v] * (dist[rowPK + pu] - dist[rowPK + pv]);
        }

        delta += (long)flow[rowU + v] * (dist[rowPV + pu] - dist[rowPU + pv])
               + (long)flow[rowV + u] * (dist[rowPU + pv] - dist[rowPV + pu]);

        return delta;
    }

    class Scanner
    {
        Stream stream;
        byte[] buffer = new byte[1024 * 1024];
        int head;
        int tail;

        public Scanner(Stream s)
        {
            stream = s;
        }

        public int NextInt()
        {
            int c = Read();
            while (c != '-' && (c < '0' || c > '9'))
            {
                if (c == -1) return -1;
                c = Read();
            }
            if (c == -1) return -1;
            int sign = 1;
            if (c == '-')
            {
                sign = -1;
                c = Read();
            }
            int res = 0;
            while (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
            {
                res = res * 10 + c - '0';
                c = Read();
            }
            return res * sign;
        }

        int Read()
        {
            if (head >= tail)
            {
                head = 0;
                tail = stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
                if (tail <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[head++];
        }
    }
}

import sys
import math

def calculate_distance(p1, p2):
    return math.sqrt((p1[0] - p2[0])**2 + (p1[1] - p2[1])**2)

def solve():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not input_data:
        return
    
    ptr = 0
    N = int(input_data[ptr])
    K = int(input_data[ptr+1])
    CAPACITY = int(input_data[ptr+2])
    ptr += 3
    
    depot = (float(input_data[ptr]), float(input_data[ptr+1]))
    ptr += 2
    
    customers = []
    for i in range(N):
        customers.append({
            'id': i,
            'pos': (float(input_data[ptr]), float(input_data[ptr+1])),
            'demand': int(input_data[ptr+2])
        })
        ptr += 3
        
    savings = []
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(i + 1, N):
            dist_i0 = calculate_distance(customers[i]['pos'], depot)
            dist_0j = calculate_distance(depot, customers[j]['pos'])
            dist_ij = calculate_distance(customers[i]['pos'], customers[j]['pos'])
            s = dist_i0 + dist_0j - dist_ij
            savings.append((s, i, j))
    
    savings.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)
    
    routes = [[i] for i in range(N)]
    route_demands = [customers[i]['demand'] for i in range(N)]
    route_map = {i: i for i in range(N)}
    route_ends = {i: (i, i) for i in range(N)}
    
    for s, i, j in savings:
        r1 = route_map[i]
        r2 = route_map[j]
        
        if r1 == r2:
            continue
            
        if route_demands[r1] + route_demands[r2] > CAPACITY:
            continue
            
        start1, end1 = route_ends[r1]
        start2, end2 = route_ends[r2]
        
        merged = False
        if end1 == i and start2 == j:
            new_route = routes[r1] + routes[r2]
            new_ends = (start1, end2)
            merged = True
        elif end1 == i and end2 == j:
            new_route = routes[r1] + routes[r2][::-1]
            new_ends = (start1, start2)
            merged = True
        elif start1 == i and start2 == j:
            new_route = routes[r1][::-1] + routes[r2]
            new_ends = (end1, end2)
            merged = True
        elif start1 == i and end2 == j:
            new_route = routes[r2] + routes[r1]
            new_ends = (start2, end1)
            merged = True
            
        if merged:
            routes[r1] = new_route
            route_demands[r1] += route_demands[r2]
            route_ends[r1] = new_ends
            routes[r2] = []
            route_demands[r2] = 0
            for node in new_route:
                route_map[node] = r1
            
    final_routes = [r for r in routes if r]
    
    total_dist = 0
    for route in final_routes:
        total_dist += calculate_distance(depot, customers[route[0]]['pos'])
        for k in range(len(route) - 1):
            total_dist += calculate_distance(customers[route[k]]['pos'], customers[route[k+1]]['pos'])
        total_dist += calculate_distance(customers[route[-1]]['pos'], depot)
        
    print(f"{total_dist:.4f}")
    print(len(final_routes))
    for route in final_routes:
        print(" ".join(map(str, route)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

use std::io::{self, BufRead};

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut lines = stdin.lock().lines();

    let first_line = match lines.next() {
        Some(Ok(l)) => l,
        _ => return,
    };
    let parts: Vec<usize> = first_line.split_whitespace().map(|s| s.parse().unwrap()).collect();
    if parts.len() < 2 { return; }
    let num_vertices = parts[0];
    let num_edges = parts[1];

    let mut adj = vec![Vec::new(); num_vertices];
    for _ in 0..num_edges {
        if let Some(Ok(line)) = lines.next() {
            let edge: Vec<usize> = line.split_whitespace().map(|s| s.parse().unwrap()).collect();
            if edge.len() >= 2 {
                adj[edge[0]].push(edge[1]);
                adj[edge[1]].push(edge[0]);
            }
        }
    }

    let mut covered = vec![false; num_vertices];
    let mut dominating_set = Vec::new();
    let mut num_covered = 0;

    while num_covered < num_vertices {
        let mut best_v = None;
        let mut max_cover_count = 0;

        for v in 0..num_vertices {
            let mut cover_count = 0;
            if !covered[v] {
                cover_count += 1;
            }
            for &neighbor in &adj[v] {
                if !covered[neighbor] {
                    cover_count += 1;
                }
            }

            if cover_count > max_cover_count {
                max_cover_count = cover_count;
                best_v = Some(v);
            }
        }

        if let Some(v) = best_v {
            dominating_set.push(v);
            if !covered[v] {
                covered[v] = true;
                num_covered += 1;
            }
            for &neighbor in &adj[v] {
                if !covered[neighbor] {
                    covered[neighbor] = true;
                    num_covered += 1;
                }
            }
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }

    println!("{}", dominating_set.len());
    let output: Vec<String> = dominating_set.iter().map(|v| v.to_string()).collect();
    println!("{}", output.join(" "));
}

Find the largest group of nodes in a graph such that no two nodes in the group are connected by an edge. Think of seating people at a dinner party where certain pairs don’t get along — seat as many guests as possible with no feuding neighbours at the same table.

This is NP-hard. The test uses planted instances with a known optimal answer for strict pass/fail grading. Subpasses increase the graph size.

Approach: The Maximum Independent Set problem is NP-hard. The provided C++ solution uses a backtracking algorithm with pruning (via a bitset for efficient set operations and a degree-based heuristic) to find the exact maximum independent set.

View C++ Code (1951 chars)
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <bitset>

using namespace std;

// Maximum number of vertices for the problem constraints.
// Using a bitset for the adjacency matrix and sets.
const int MAXN = 100;
bitset<MAXN> adj[MAXN];
bitset<MAXN> best_set;
int max_k = 0;

void solve(bitset<MAXN> P, bitset<MAXN> current_set, int k) {
    if (P.none()) {
        if (k > max_k) {
            max_k = k;
            best_set = current_set;
        }
        return;
    }

    // Pruning: if current k + remaining possible vertices <= max_k, return.
    if (k + (int)P.count() <= max_k) {
        return;
    }

    // Heuristic: pick the vertex with the highest degree in the subgraph P.
    int v = -1;
    int max_degree = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) {
        if (P.test(i)) {
            int degree = (int)(adj[i] & P).count();
            if (degree > max_degree) {
                max_degree = degree;
                v = i;
            }
        }
    }

    if (v == -1) return;

    // Branch 1: include v in the independent set
    bitset<MAXN> next_P = P & ~adj[v];
    next_P.reset(v);
    solve(next_P, current_set | bitset<MAXN>().set(v), k + 1);

    // Branch 2: exclude v
    P.reset(v);
    solve(P, current_set, k);
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int n, m;
    if (!(cin >> n >> m)) return 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        if (u >= 0 && u < n && v >= 0 && v < n && u != v) {
            adj[u].set(v);
            adj[v].set(u);
        }
    }

    bitset<MAXN> P;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) P.set(i);

    solve(P, bitset<MAXN>(), 0);

    cout << max_k << "\n";
    bool first = true;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (best_set.test(i)) {
            if (!first) cout << " ";
            cout << i;
            first = false;
        }
    }
    cout << endl;

    return 0;
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

class FastScanner {
    private System.IO.Stream stream;
    private byte[] buffer = new byte[1024 * 1024];
    private int head = 0;
    private int tail = 0;

    public FastScanner() {
        stream = System.Console.OpenStandardInput();
    }

    public int NextInt() {
        int c = Read();
        while (c <= 32) {
            if (c == -1) return -1;
            c = Read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        while (c > 32) {
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = Read();
        }
        return res;
    }

    private int Read() {
        if (head >= tail) {
            head = 0;
            tail = stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
            if (tail == 0) return -1;
        }
        return buffer[head++];
    }
}

class Graph {
    public HashSet<int> Vertices = new HashSet<int>();
    public Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>> InEdges = new Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>>();
    public Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>> OutEdges = new Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>>();

    public void AddVertex(int v) {
        if (Vertices.Add(v)) {
            InEdges[v] = new HashSet<int>();
            OutEdges[v] = new HashSet<int>();
        }
    }

    public void AddEdge(int u, int v) {
        OutEdges[u].Add(v);
        InEdges[v].Add(u);
    }

    public void RemoveVertex(int v) {
        if (!Vertices.Contains(v)) return;
        foreach (var u in InEdges[v]) OutEdges[u].Remove(v);
        foreach (var w in OutEdges[v]) InEdges[w].Remove(v);
        InEdges.Remove(v);
        OutEdges.Remove(v);
        Vertices.Remove(v);
    }

    public void RemoveEdge(int u, int v) {
        OutEdges[u].Remove(v);
        InEdges[v].Remove(u);
    }

    public Graph Copy() {
        Graph g = new Graph();
        foreach (var v in Vertices) {
            g.AddVertex(v);
        }
        foreach (var v in Vertices) {
            foreach (var w in OutEdges[v]) {
                g.AddEdge(v, w);
            }
        }
        return g;
    }
}

class Program {
    public static System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch sw = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();

    static List<List<int>> FindSCCs(Graph G) {
        var sccs = new List<List<int>>();
        var visited = new HashSet<int>();
        var order = new List<int>();
        
        var edgeIndex = new Dictionary<int, int>();
        var outEdgesList = new Dictionary<int, List<int>>();

        foreach (var startNode in G.Vertices) {
            if (visited.Contains(startNode)) continue;
            
            var stack = new Stack<int>();
            stack.Push(startNode);
            
            while (stack.Count > 0) {
                int v = stack.Peek();
                if (!visited.Contains(v)) {
                    visited.Add(v);
                    outEdgesList[v] = G.OutEdges[v].ToList();
                    edgeIndex[v] = 0;
                }
                
                bool pushed = false;
                var list = outEdgesList[v];
                int idx = edgeIndex[v];
                
                while (idx < list.Count) {
                    int w = list[idx++];
                    if (!visited.Contains(w)) {
                        edgeIndex[v] = idx;
                        stack.Push(w);
                        pushed = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                
                if (!pushed) {
                    stack.Pop();
                    order.Add(v);
                }
            }
        }

        visited.Clear();
        order.Reverse();

        foreach (var startNode in order) {
            if (visited.Contains(startNode)) continue;
            
            var scc = new List<int>();
            var stack = new Stack<int>();
            stack.Push(startNode);
            visited.Add(startNode);
            
            while (stack.Count > 0) {
                int v = stack.Pop();
                scc.Add(v);
                
                foreach (var w in G.InEdges[v]) {
                    if (!visited.Contains(w)) {
                        visited.Add(w);
                        stack.Push(w);
                    }
                }
            }
            sccs.Add(scc);
        }

        return sccs;
    }

    static void Reduce(Graph G, List<int> currentFVS) {
        bool changed = true;
        while (changed) {
            changed = false;
            
            bool localChanged = true;
            while (localChanged) {
                localChanged = false;
                var vertices = G.Vertices.ToList();
                foreach (var v in vertices) {
                    if (!G.Vertices.Contains(v)) continue;
                    
                    if (G.OutEdges[v].Contains(v)) {
                        currentFVS.Add(v);
                        G.RemoveVertex(v);
                        localChanged = true;
                        continue;
                    }
                    
                    if (G.InEdges[v].Count == 0 || G.OutEdges[v].Count == 0) {
                        G.RemoveVertex(v);
                        localChanged = true;
                        continue;
                    }
                    
                    if (G.InEdges[v].Count == 1 || G.OutEdges[v].Count == 1) {
                        var in_edges = G.InEdges[v].ToList();
                        var out_edges = G.OutEdges[v].ToList();
                        G.RemoveVertex(v);
                        foreach (var u in in_edges) {
                            foreach (var w in out_edges) {
                                G.AddEdge(u, w);
                            }
                        }
                        localChanged = true;
                    }
                }
                if (localChanged) changed = true;
            }
            
            if (G.Vertices.Count == 0) break;
            
            var sccs = FindSCCs(G);
            if (sccs.Count > 1) {
                var sccMap = new Dictionary<int, int>();
                for(int i = 0; i < sccs.Count; i++) {
                    foreach(var v in sccs[i]) sccMap[v] = i;
                }
                
                int removedEdges = 0;
                var vertices = G.Vertices.ToList();
                foreach (var v in vertices) {
                    if (!G.Vertices.Contains(v)) continue;
                    var outEdges = G.OutEdges[v].ToList();
                    foreach (var w in outEdges) {
                        if (sccMap[v] != sccMap[w]) {
                            G.RemoveEdge(v, w);
                            removedEdges++;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (removedEdges > 0) changed = true;
            }
        }
    }

    static int ComputeLowerBound(Graph G) {
        var visited = new HashSet<int>();
        int lb = 0;
        foreach(var v in G.Vertices) {
            if (visited.Contains(v)) continue;
            foreach(var u in G.OutEdges[v]) {
                if (visited.Contains(u)) continue;
                if (G.OutEdges[u].Contains(v)) {
                    lb++;
                    visited.Add(u);
                    visited.Add(v);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        return lb;
    }

    static List<int> GreedyFVS(Graph G) {
        Graph g = G.Copy();
        List<int> fvs = new List<int>();
        while(g.Vertices.Count > 0) {
            bool changed = true;
            while(changed) {
                changed = false;
                foreach(var v in g.Vertices.ToList()) {
                    if (!g.Vertices.Contains(v)) continue;
                    if (g.OutEdges[v].Contains(v)) {
                        fvs.Add(v);
                        g.RemoveVertex(v);
                        changed = true;
                    } else if (g.InEdges[v].Count == 0 || g.OutEdges[v].Count == 0) {
                        g.RemoveVertex(v);
                        changed = true;
                    } else if (g.InEdges[v].Count == 1 || g.OutEdges[v].Count == 1) {
                        var in_edges = g.InEdges[v].ToList();
                        var out_edges = g.OutEdges[v].ToList();
                        g.RemoveVertex(v);

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

class FastScanner {
    private System.IO.Stream stream;
    private byte[] buffer = new byte[1024 * 1024];
    private int head = 0;
    private int tail = 0;

    public FastScanner() {
        stream = System.Console.OpenStandardInput();
    }

    public int NextInt() {
        int c = Read();
        while (c <= 32) {
            if (c == -1) return -1;
            c = Read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        while (c > 32) {
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = Read();
        }
        return res;
    }

    private int Read() {
        if (head >= tail) {
            head = 0;
            tail = stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
            if (tail == 0) return -1;
        }
        return buffer[head++];
    }
}

class Graph {
    public HashSet<int> Vertices = new HashSet<int>();
    public Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>> InEdges = new Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>>();
    public Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>> OutEdges = new Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>>();

    public void AddVertex(int v) {
        if (Vertices.Add(v)) {
            InEdges[v] = new HashSet<int>();
            OutEdges[v] = new HashSet<int>();
        }
    }

    public void AddEdge(int u, int v) {
        OutEdges[u].Add(v);
        InEdges[v].Add(u);
    }

    public void RemoveVertex(int v) {
        if (!Vertices.Contains(v)) return;
        foreach (var u in InEdges[v]) OutEdges[u].Remove(v);
        foreach (var w in OutEdges[v]) InEdges[w].Remove(v);
        InEdges.Remove(v);
        OutEdges.Remove(v);
        Vertices.Remove(v);
    }

    public void RemoveEdge(int u, int v) {
        OutEdges[u].Remove(v);
        InEdges[v].Remove(u);
    }

    public Graph Copy() {
        Graph g = new Graph();
        foreach (var v in Vertices) {
            g.AddVertex(v);
        }
        foreach (var v in Vertices) {
            foreach (var w in OutEdges[v]) {
                g.AddEdge(v, w);
            }
        }
        return g;
    }
}

            var stack = new Stack<int>();
            stack.Push(startNode);

                if (!visited.Contains(v)) {
                    visited.Add(v);
                    outEdgesList[v] = G.OutEdges[v].ToList();
                    edgeIndex[v] = 0;
                }

                var list = outEdgesList[v];
                int idx = edgeIndex[v];
                
                while (idx < list.Count) {
                    int w = list[idx++];
                    if (!visited.Contains(w)) {
                        edgeIndex[v] = idx;
                        stack.Push(w);
                        pushed = true;
                        break;
                    }

                    stack.Pop();
                    order.Add(v);

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

class FastScanner {
    private System.IO.Stream stream;
    private byte[] buffer = new byte[1024 * 1024];
    private int head = 0;
    private int tail = 0;

    public FastScanner() {
        stream = System.Console.OpenStandardInput();
    }

    public int NextInt() {
        int c = Read();
        while (c <= 32) {
            if (c == -1) return -1;
            c = Read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        while (c > 32) {
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = Read();
        }
        return res;
    }

    private int Read() {
        if (head >= tail) {
            head = 0;
            tail = stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
            if (tail == 0) return -1;
        }
        return buffer[head++];
    }
}

class Graph {
    public HashSet<int> Vertices = new HashSet<int>();
    public Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>> InEdges = new Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>>();
    public Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>> OutEdges = new Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>>();

    public void AddVertex(int v) {
        if (Vertices.Add(v)) {
            InEdges[v] = new HashSet<int>();
            OutEdges[v] = new HashSet<int>();
        }
    }

    public void AddEdge(int u, int v) {
        OutEdges[u].Add(v);
        InEdges[v].Add(u);
    }

    public void RemoveVertex(int v) {
        if (!Vertices.Contains(v)) return;
        foreach (var u in InEdges[v]) OutEdges[u].Remove(v);
        foreach (var w in OutEdges[v]) InEdges[w].Remove(v);
        InEdges.Remove(v);
        OutEdges.Remove(v);
        Vertices.Remove(v);
    }

    public void RemoveEdge(int u, int v) {
        OutEdges[u].Remove(v);
        InEdges[v].Remove(u);
    }

    public Graph Copy() {
        Graph g = new Graph();
        foreach (var v in Vertices) {
            g.AddVertex(v);
        }
        foreach (var v in Vertices) {
            foreach (var w in OutEdges[v]) {
                g.AddEdge(v, w);
            }
        }
        return g;
    }
}

        var sccs = new List<List<int>>();

        var order = new List<int>();
        
        var edgeIndex = new Dictionary<int, int>();
        var outEdgesList = new Dictionary<int, List<int>>();

        foreach (var startNode in G.Vertices) {
            if (visited.Contains(startNode)) continue;
            
            var stack = new Stack<int>();
            stack.Push(startNode);
            
            while (stack.Count > 0) {
                int v = stack.Peek();
                if (!visited.Contains(v)) {
                    visited.Add(v);
                    outEdgesList[v] = G.OutEdges[v].ToList();
                    edgeIndex[v] = 0;
                }
                
                bool pushed = false;
                var list = outEdgesList[v];
                int idx = edgeIndex[v];
                
                while (idx < list.Count) {
                    int w = list[idx++];
                    if (!visited.Contains(w)) {
                        edgeIndex[v] = idx;
                        stack.Push(w);
                        pushed = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                
                if (!pushed) {
                    stack.Pop();
                    order.Add(v);
                }
            }
        }

        visited.Clear();
        order.Reverse();

            if (visited.Contains(startNode)) continue;
            
            var scc = new List<int>();
            var stack = new Stack<int>();
            stack.Push(startNode);
            visited.Add(startNode);

                scc.Add(v);
                
                foreach (var w in G.InEdges[v]) {
                    if (!visited.Contains(w)) {

                        stack.Push(w);
                    }
                }

            sccs.Add(scc);
        }

        return sccs;
    }

                        localChanged = true;
                        continue;

                        G.RemoveVertex(v);
                        localChanged = true;
                        continue;
                    }
                    
                    if (G.InEdges[v].Count == 1 || G.OutEdges[v].Count == 1) {

                        var out_edges = G.OutEdges[v].ToList();
                        G.RemoveVertex(v);
                        foreach (var u in in_edges) {

                            }

                        }

        var visited = new HashSet<int>();

        foreach(var v in G.Vertices) {

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

class FastScanner {
    private System.IO.Stream stream;
    private byte[] buffer = new byte[1024 * 1024];
    private int head = 0;
    private int tail = 0;

    public FastScanner() {
        stream = System.Console.OpenStandardInput();
    }

    public int NextInt() {
        int c = Read();
        while (c <= 32) {
            if (c == -1) return -1;
            c = Read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        while (c > 32) {
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = Read();
        }
        return res;
    }

    private int Read() {
        if (head >= tail) {
            head = 0;
            tail = stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
            if (tail == 0) return -1;
        }
        return buffer[head++];
    }
}

class Graph {
    public HashSet<int> Vertices = new HashSet<int>();
    public Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>> InEdges = new Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>>();
    public Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>> OutEdges = new Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>>();

    public void AddVertex(int v) {
        if (Vertices.Add(v)) {
            InEdges[v] = new HashSet<int>();
            OutEdges[v] = new HashSet<int>();
        }
    }

    public void AddEdge(int u, int v) {
        OutEdges[u].Add(v);
        InEdges[v].Add(u);
    }

    public void RemoveVertex(int v) {
        if (!Vertices.Contains(v)) return;
        foreach (var u in InEdges[v]) OutEdges[u].Remove(v);
        foreach (var w in OutEdges[v]) InEdges[w].Remove(v);
        InEdges.Remove(v);
        OutEdges.Remove(v);
        Vertices.Remove(v);
    }

    public void RemoveEdge(int u, int v) {
        OutEdges[u].Remove(v);
        InEdges[v].Remove(u);
    }

    public Graph Copy() {
        Graph g = new Graph();
        foreach (var v in Vertices) {
            g.AddVertex(v);
        }
        foreach (var v in Vertices) {
            foreach (var w in OutEdges[v]) {
                g.AddEdge(v, w);
            }
        }
        return g;
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

class FastScanner {
    private System.IO.Stream stream;
    private byte[] buffer = new byte[1024 * 1024];
    private int head = 0;
    private int tail = 0;

    public FastScanner() {
        stream = System.Console.OpenStandardInput();
    }

    public int NextInt() {
        int c = Read();
        while (c <= 32) {
            if (c == -1) return -1;
            c = Read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        while (c > 32) {
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = Read();
        }
        return res;
    }

    private int Read() {
        if (head >= tail) {
            head = 0;
            tail = stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
            if (tail == 0) return -1;
        }
        return buffer[head++];
    }
}

class Graph {
    public HashSet<int> Vertices = new HashSet<int>();
    public Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>> InEdges = new Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>>();
    public Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>> OutEdges = new Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>>();

    public void AddVertex(int v) {
        if (Vertices.Add(v)) {
            InEdges[v] = new HashSet<int>();
            OutEdges[v] = new HashSet<int>();
        }
    }

    public void AddEdge(int u, int v) {
        OutEdges[u].Add(v);
        InEdges[v].Add(u);
    }

    public void RemoveVertex(int v) {
        if (!Vertices.Contains(v)) return;
        foreach (var u in InEdges[v]) OutEdges[u].Remove(v);
        foreach (var w in OutEdges[v]) InEdges[w].Remove(v);
        InEdges.Remove(v);
        OutEdges.Remove(v);
        Vertices.Remove(v);
    }

    public void RemoveEdge(int u, int v) {
        OutEdges[u].Remove(v);
        InEdges[v].Remove(u);
    }

    public Graph Copy() {
        Graph g = new Graph();
        foreach (var v in Vertices) {
            g.AddVertex(v);
        }
        foreach (var v in Vertices) {
            foreach (var w in OutEdges[v]) {
                g.AddEdge(v, w);
            }
        }
        return g;
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

class FastScanner {
    private System.IO.Stream stream;
    private byte[] buffer = new byte[1024 * 1024];
    private int head = 0;
    private int tail = 0;

    public FastScanner() {
        stream = System.Console.OpenStandardInput();
    }

    public int NextInt() {
        int c = Read();
        while (c <= 32) {
            if (c == -1) return -1;
            c = Read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        while (c > 32) {
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = Read();
        }
        return res;
    }

    private int Read() {
        if (head >= tail) {
            head = 0;
            tail = stream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length);
            if (tail == 0) return -1;
        }
        return buffer[head++];
    }
}

class Graph {
    public HashSet<int> Vertices = new HashSet<int>();
    public Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>> InEdges = new Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>>();
    public Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>> OutEdges = new Dictionary<int, HashSet<int>>();

    public void AddVertex(int v) {
        if (Vertices.Add(v)) {
            InEdges[v] = new HashSet<int>();
            OutEdges[v] = new HashSet<int>();
        }
    }

    public void AddEdge(int u, int v) {
        OutEdges[u].Add(v);
        InEdges[v].Add(u);
    }

    public void RemoveVertex(int v) {
        if (!Vertices.Contains(v)) return;
        foreach (var u in InEdges[v]) OutEdges[u].Remove(v);
        foreach (var w in OutEdges[v]) InEdges[w].Remove(v);
        InEdges.Remove(v);
        OutEdges.Remove(v);
        Vertices.Remove(v);
    }

    public void RemoveEdge(int u, int v) {
        OutEdges[u].Remove(v);
        InEdges[v].Remove(u);
    }

    public Graph Copy() {
        Graph g = new Graph();
        foreach (var v in Vertices) {
            g.AddVertex(v);
        }
        foreach (var v in Vertices) {
            foreach (var w in OutEdges[v]) {
                g.AddEdge(v, w);
            }
        }
        return g;
    }
}
